+"""Deterministically archive completed cells and all sampled resource records."""
+import gzip,hashlib,importlib.metadata,json,pathlib,shutil,subprocess,sys,time
+root=pathlib.Path('/home/youwei/bzh/project/TokenCake/RFC/sglang-rfc')
+base=pathlib.Path('/tmp/sglang-rfc-build/mem08')
+dest=root/'benchmark/session_kv_control/results/2026-11-04-mem08'
+prov=dest/'provenance'
+def sha(p):
+ h=hashlib.sha256()
+ with p.open('rb') as f:
+  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(b)
+ return h.hexdigest()
+def pack(source,target):
+ with source.open('rb') as inp,target.open('wb') as out:
+  with gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=out,mtime=0,compresslevel=6) as z:shutil.copyfileobj(inp,z)
+for name in [f'l3-c{c}-natural-optimized' for c in [8,16,32]]:
+ source=base/name;target=dest/name;assert not target.exists()
+ original=json.loads((source/'checksums.json').read_text())
+ for file,expected in original.items():assert sha(source/file)==expected,(name,file)
+ target.mkdir()
+ for p in source.iterdir():
+  if not p.is_file() or p.name=='checksums.json':continue
+  if p.name=='raw.jsonl' or (p.suffix=='.json' and p.stat().st_size>32768):pack(p,target/(p.name+'.gz'))
+  else:shutil.copy2(p,target/p.name)
+ shutil.copy2(source/'checksums.json',target/'checksums-original.json')
+ (target/'checksums.json').write_text(json.dumps({p.name:sha(p) for p in sorted(target.iterdir()) if p.is_file()},indent=2)+'\n')
+ print('Archived',name,flush=True)
+# The first commit's L2-only view is retained verbatim; full capture uses bounded parts.
+clip=dest/'resources.jsonl.gz'
+assert clip.is_file()
+clip.rename(prov/'resources-l2-clipped.jsonl.gz')
+parts=[];full=hashlib.sha256();out=None;z=None;records=0;first=None;last=None;name=None
+with (base/'resources.jsonl').open('rb') as inp:
+ for line in inp:
+  row=json.loads(line);full.update(line)
+  if records%512==0:
+   if z is not None:
+    z.close();out.close();parts.append({'file':name,'sha256':sha(dest/name),'records':512,'first_monotonic':first,'last_monotonic':last})
+   name=f'resources-{len(parts):03d}.jsonl.gz';out=(dest/name).open('wb');z=gzip.GzipFile(filename='',mode='wb',fileobj=out,mtime=0,compresslevel=6);first=row['monotonic']
+  z.write(line);last=row['monotonic'];records+=1
+if z is not None:
+ z.close();out.close();parts.append({'file':name,'sha256':sha(dest/name),'records':records-512*len(parts),'first_monotonic':first,'last_monotonic':last})
+assert full.hexdigest()==sha(base/'resources.jsonl')
+(dest/'resources-index.json').write_text(json.dumps({'parts':parts,'records':records,'uncompressed_full_sha256':full.hexdigest(),'definition':'all original complete JSONL observer records in original order; deterministic gzip split at 512 records; no metric filtering'},indent=2)+'\n')
+# Prove lossless reconstruction, independently of the part checksum index.
+reconstructed=hashlib.sha256()
+for part in parts:
+ with gzip.open(dest/part['file'],'rb') as f:
+  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):reconstructed.update(b)
+assert reconstructed.hexdigest()==full.hexdigest()
+pack(base/'process-resources.jsonl',dest/'process-resources.jsonl.gz')
+for p in sorted(base.iterdir()):
+ if p.is_file() and (p.suffix in ['.py','.log','.json'] or p.name=='CHECKPOINT.md') and p.name not in ['resources.jsonl','process-resources.jsonl']:
+  if p.name.startswith('engine') or p.name=='master.log':pack(p,prov/(p.name+'.gz'))
+  else:shutil.copy2(p,prov/p.name)
+# Separate startup/function-only observations from formal cells.
+observations=dest/'startup-observations';observations.mkdir()
+for name in ['calibration-0','l3-smoke','l3-smoke-v2','l2-smoke']:
+ source=base/name;target=observations/name
+ if not source.exists():continue
+ target.mkdir()
+ for p in source.iterdir():
+  if not p.is_file() or p.name=='checksums.json':continue
+  if p.name=='raw.jsonl' or (p.suffix=='.json' and p.stat().st_size>32768):pack(p,target/(p.name+'.gz'))
+  else:shutil.copy2(p,target/p.name)
+ if (source/'checksums.json').exists():shutil.copy2(source/'checksums.json',target/'checksums-original.json')
+ (target/'checksums.json').write_text(json.dumps({p.name:sha(p) for p in sorted(target.iterdir()) if p.is_file()},indent=2)+'\n')
+versions={}
+for name in ['torch','transformers','msgspec','numpy','matplotlib','mooncake-transfer-engine-cuda13','sgl-kernel']:
+ try:versions[name]=importlib.metadata.version(name)
+ except importlib.metadata.PackageNotFoundError:versions[name]=None
+(prov/'pack-environment.json').write_text(json.dumps({'python':sys.version,'versions_distribution_lookup':versions,'runtime_old':'f65f0393c4c916184c6c9017fafb9fa389ec2f4a','runtime_optimized':'ff764308fbb40de10f8e3983cd01d3f54946863e','pack_tool_revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),'observer_records':records,'observer_parts':len(parts),'source_global_resource_sha256':full.hexdigest(),'lossless_reconstructed_sha256':reconstructed.hexdigest(),'wall_time':time.time()},indent=2)+'\n')
+print('All captures archived losslessly:',records,'samples in',len(parts),'parts',flush=True)

+import sys
+import threading
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/sglang-rfc-build/mem08-native-worktree/test/registered/unit/mem_cache')
+import test_kv_control_transfers as fixtures
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.service import CacheLimits, ServiceConfig
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.contracts import Status
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.base_prefix_cache import CacheRequestHandle
+
+class Repro(fixtures.TestKVControlStorageReads):
+    def runTest(self):
+        config = ServiceConfig(namespace='ns', engine_id='engine', cache_limits=CacheLimits(max_concurrent_storage_reads=1))
+        with fixtures.hicache(self, config, namespace_keys=True) as owner:
+            _, cache, service, _ = owner
+            scopes = [fixtures.cache_fixtures.target(cache_salt=f'repro-{i}') for i in range(2)]
+            self._cold_scopes(owner, scopes)
+            cc = cache.cache_controller
+            query, get = cc._storage_hit_query, cc.page_get_func
+            first_get, ordinary_get, release_first, release_ordinary = (threading.Event() for _ in range(4))
+            queries, gets = [], []
+            demand = CacheRequestHandle('queued-demand-repro', 0)
+            def counted_query(operation):
+                queries.append(operation.request_id)
+                return query(operation)
+            def controlled_get(operation, *args, **kwargs):
+                gets.append(operation.request_id)
+                if len(gets) == 1:
+                    first_get.set()
+                    assert release_first.wait(5)
+                if operation.request_id == demand.rid:
+                    ordinary_get.set()
+                    assert release_ordinary.wait(5)
+                return get(operation, *args, **kwargs)
+            try:
+                with patch.object(cc, '_storage_hit_query', counted_query), patch.object(cc, 'page_get_func', controlled_get), patch.object(cache, 'prefetch_stop_policy', 'wait_complete'), patch.object(cache, 'prefetch_threshold', 1):
+                    first = self._restore(service, scopes[0], 'first')
+                    fixtures.wait_for(service, first_get.is_set)
+                    second = self._restore(service, scopes[1], 'second')
+                    reads = service.control.executor.storage_reads
+                    self.assertIsNone(reads.interests[second.ref.operation_id].job.operation)
+                    cache.prefetch_from_storage(demand, cache.tree_core.root_node.id, fixtures.cache_fixtures.array('q', scopes[1].token_ids), matched_prefix_tokens=[], cache_salt=service.cache_salt(scopes[1].cache_salt))
+                    joined = demand in reads.demands
+                    if not joined:
+                        fixtures.wait_for(service, lambda: len(queries) == 2)
+                        release_first.set()
+                        fixtures.wait_for(service, ordinary_get.is_set)
+                        fixtures.wait_for(service, lambda: len(queries) == 3)
+                    release_first.set()
+                    release_ordinary.set()
+                    self.assertEqual(fixtures.wait(service, first).status, Status.COMPLETED)
+                    self.assertEqual(fixtures.wait(service, second).status, Status.COMPLETED)
+                    def ready():
+                        cache.drain_storage_control_queues()
+                        return cache.check_prefetch_progress(demand)
+                    fixtures.wait_for(service, ready)
+                    span = cache.pop_prefetch_loaded_span(demand)
+                    cache.discard_storage_prefetch_accounting(demand)
+                    service.progress()
+                    print({'joined_while_queued': joined, 'physical_queries': len(queries), 'physical_gets': len(gets), 'demand_span': span}, flush=True)
+                    fixtures.assert_retired(cache, service)
+                    cache.sanity_check()
+            finally:
+                release_first.set()
+                release_ordinary.set()
+                cache.release_aborted_request(demand)
+
+case = Repro()
+result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(unittest.TestSuite([case]))
+raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())

+analysis=json.loads((root/'analysis/analysis.json').read_text())
+cells={c['name']:c for c in analysis['cells'] if c['state']=='completed'}
+rows=[]
+for name,c in cells.items():
+ a=c['groups']['on_demand'];key='pin' if c['args']['command']=='l2' else 'prefetch';b=c['groups'][key]
+ rows.append({'cell':name,'candidate':key,'mean_ttft_delta_percent':100*(b['resume_ttft_ms']['mean']/a['resume_ttft_ms']['mean']-1),
+  'p95_ttft_delta_percent':100*(b['resume_ttft_ms']['p95']/a['resume_ttft_ms']['p95']-1),
+  'work_throughput_delta_percent':100*(b['work_excluding_flush_completed_requests_per_s']/a['work_excluding_flush_completed_requests_per_s']-1),
+  'client_cycle_delta_percent':100*(b['client_cycle_ms']['mean']/a['client_cycle_ms']['mean']-1) if a['client_cycle_ms']['mean'] else None,

+(root/'analysis/paired-relative.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')

+ w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(rows[0]));w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)
+# Every matching actual input must retain the same generated IDs/text across code snapshots and load levels.
+expected={};checked=0;prefixes={};total_input=total_output=0
+for name,c in cells.items():
+ p=root/name;manifest=read_json(locate(p,'manifest.json'));args=manifest['args']
+ signature=(manifest['input']['prefix_sha256'],manifest['input']['suffix_sha256'],args['seed'],args['output_tokens'])
+ for spec in read_json(locate(p,'schedule.json')):
+  arm=read_json(locate(p,spec['id']+'.json'))
+  for r in arm['rows']:
+   if r.get('generation'):
+    meta=r['generation']['meta_info'];total_input+=meta['prompt_tokens'];total_output+=meta['completion_tokens']
+   if r.get('phase')=='resume' and r.get('generation'):
+    prior=expected.setdefault(signature,r['generation']);assert output_equal(prior,r['generation']),(name,r['id'])

+(root/'analysis/output-proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')

+with gzip.open(root/'process-resources.jsonl.gz','rt') as f: cpu=[json.loads(line) for line in f]
+times=[r['monotonic'] for r in cpu]
+results=[]
+def counters(sample,role):
+ out={}
+ for p in sample['roles'].get(role,{}).get('processes',[]):
+  if all(k in p for k in ['pid','created','user_s','system_s']):out[(p['pid'],p['created'])]=p['user_s']+p['system_s']
+ return out
+for name,c in cells.items():
+ for window in c['arm_windows']:
+  start=window['work_start'] if window['work_start'] is not None else window['start'];end=window['end']
+  lo=bisect.bisect_left(times,start);hi=bisect.bisect_right(times,end)-1
+  rec={'cell':name,'arm_id':window['id'],'group':window['arm'],'work_seconds':end-start,'roles':{}}
+  if 0<=lo<hi<len(cpu):
+   duration=times[hi]-times[lo];rec.update(observed_seconds=duration,coverage=duration/(end-start))
+   for role in ['engine_a','engine_b','master']:
+    before,after=counters(cpu[lo],role),counters(cpu[hi],role);common=before.keys()&after.keys()

+    rec['roles'][role]={'cpu_seconds':delta,'sampled_average_cores':delta/duration,'stable_pids':len(common),'complete_endpoint_process_set':complete}
+  else:rec.update(observed_seconds=0,coverage=0)
+  results.append(rec)

+   secs=sum(r['observed_seconds'] for r in usable);work=sum(r['work_seconds'] for r in selected);cpu_s=sum(r['roles'][role]['cpu_seconds'] for r in usable)

CPU/call is an estimate only when >=90% window coverage; no inference of unique physical host RSS.'},indent=2)+'\n')

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Read-only integrity and expected-outcome verification of this measured archive."""
+import gzip,hashlib,json,sys
+from pathlib import Path
+root=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+sys.path.insert(0,str(root.parent.parent))
+from analyze_stress import Evidence,numeric_differences,resource_inputs,verify_rows
+from stress_bench import output_equal,summarize
+
+def sha(path):
+ h=hashlib.sha256()
+ with path.open('rb') as f:
+  for block in iter(lambda:f.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
+ return h.hexdigest()
+for line in (root/'SHA256SUMS').read_text().splitlines():
+ expected,name=line.split('  ',1);assert sha(root/name)==expected,name
+analysis=json.loads((root/'analysis/analysis.json').read_text())
+assert analysis['counts']['completed_formal_cells']==analysis['counts']['verified_cells']==8
+assert analysis['counts']['valid_cells']==6
+expected_invalid={
+ 'l3-c32-natural-baseline':set(json.loads((root/'provenance/baseline-reviewed.json').read_text())['expected_invalid_ids']),
+ 'l3-c32-natural-optimized':set(json.loads((root/'provenance/optimized-reviewed.json').read_text())['expected_invalid_ids'])}
+assert len(expected_invalid['l3-c32-natural-baseline'])==1
+assert len(expected_invalid['l3-c32-natural-optimized'])==4
+calls=outputs=prompt=resume=0;signatures={};cells=0
+for cell in analysis['cells']:
+ if cell['state']!='completed':continue
+ evidence=Evidence(root/cell['name']);manifest=evidence.load('manifest.json');schedule=evidence.load('schedule.json');arms=[evidence.load(x['id']+'.json') for x in schedule]
+ assert not numeric_differences(summarize(arms),evidence.load('summary.json')),cell['name']
+ errors,_=verify_rows(arms,manifest);assert not errors,(cell['name'],errors)
+ invalid=set()
+ signature=(manifest['input']['prefix_sha256'],manifest['input']['suffix_sha256'],manifest['args']['seed'],manifest['args']['output_tokens'])
+ for arm in arms:
+  for row in arm['rows']:
+   generation=row.get('generation');assert generation and (row.get('phase')!='resume' or row.get('output_equal') is True)
+   calls+=1;meta=generation['meta_info'];prompt+=meta['prompt_tokens'];outputs+=meta['completion_tokens']
+   if not row['valid']:
+    invalid.add(row['id']);op=row['prefetch']['operation'];assert not op['public_result']['ready_scope']
+    assert op['update']['code']==('whole_scope_capacity' if cell['name'].endswith('optimized') else 'incomplete_storage_read')
+   if row.get('phase')=='resume':
+    prior=signatures.setdefault(signature,generation);assert output_equal(prior,generation);resume+=1
+ assert invalid==expected_invalid.get(cell['name'],set()),(cell['name'],invalid)
+ source=evidence.load('source-publication.json',False)
+ for row in (source or {}).get('rows',[]):
+  assert row['valid'];calls+=1;meta=row['generation']['meta_info'];prompt+=meta['prompt_tokens'];outputs+=meta['completion_tokens']
+ cells+=1
+assert (cells,calls,resume,prompt,outputs)==(8,5724,4656,93879792,150060)
+parts=resource_inputs(root);digest=hashlib.sha256();records=0
+for part in parts:
+ with gzip.open(part,'rb') as handle:
+  for line in handle:json.loads(line);digest.update(line);records+=1
+index=json.loads((root/'resources-index.json').read_text())
+assert records==index['records']==4570
+assert digest.hexdigest()==index['uncompressed_full_sha256']
+cleanup=json.loads((root/'provenance/final-cleanup.json').read_text())

+assert cleanup.get('resource_observer_additional_closed')

+## Router 与保护验收
+
+P6 Router 的 8K 三次配对与路由改变负例共 7 条有效：B3 三次均自由选择准备好的 B，并实际复用全部 host 前缀。B2 直达 B 的均值 184.83ms，B3 为 159.45ms；配对 Δ −25.39ms、95% CI −83.99～30.34ms，不能认定额外选路加速。两臂使用相同 Router 准备信号，EMA 历史和直连流量的学习屏障差异有记录。见 [P6 B3 记录](router-p6-b3/router-summary.md)。

+

+16K 前台 TTFT 降低的同时，后台完成率均值下降；不能声称对普通推理没有代价。8K/16K 的完整周期配对 CI 分别为［−8719.15, 1182.02］和［−1592.09, 1159.65］ms，均跨 0。每组只有 3 条试验，且负载窗口长短不同。表中 requests/s 只计在测量窗口内成功完成的请求；按总时长加权的另一口径及边界请求计数保存在 `background-aggregate.json`。这组短测不能充当长期服务吞吐基准。
+
+host 压力组在每次目标试验前，通过真实生成与 DEMOTE 构造四条 16K 前缀；每条 DEMOTE 后的 host 查询均观察到 16384 token。该记录表明压力内容确实进入 host；它没有测量四条同时常驻的字节峰值。压力构造平均花费 8831.54ms 的生成时间，另有 transfer 耗时，这些预置成本不计入上述完整前台周期。
+
+该组 6/6 场景有效，prefetch 恢复前 ready 为 0/3，恢复请求均报告 CPU 命中 0、storage 命中 8192 token。prefetch 控制操作事后完成，不能据此声明恢复时已提前就绪。on_demand/prefetch TTFT 为 759.44/819.89ms，配对 Δ=+60.44ms，CI［36.92, 81.55］；完整周期为 5645.87/5841.11ms，Δ=+195.24ms，CI［−116.66, 656.90］。这组结果显示所测压力条件下提前准备没有带来前台收益。
+
+区间采用配对差值的 percentile bootstrap，4000 次重采样。原始 P3 两组 summary 未记录 CI，本包从完整 raw 配对离线补算，`paired.csv` 标明 `offline_recomputed_from_raw`；其余已有 CI 沿用原 summary，部分增量比较的周期 CI 也明确标为补算。每个采样单元是同一运行内部的一对请求，不把不同快照的样本合并重采样。N=3/4/6/10 都很小，单机时序相关与状态漂移也会限制解释；p95/p99 仅是插值统计，保存在 `groups.csv`，不表示尾延迟保证。ready 子集是执行后选择，只作描述，主结论保持全部完成样本。
+
+这批性能证据尚未覆盖 shared-prefix ratio 扫描、真实 RL rollout/真实工具轨迹、端到端 Router B3 策略对照、多 rank/Hybrid/PD，也未观测物理 I/O 去重字节、host 峰值、服务端 CPU 或长期吞吐。Router 的现场功能验收由另一项记录补充，此处没有把直接 Engine 控制实验写成已完成的 Router 策略性能结果。
+
+离线重算与完整性检查可在该目录执行：
+
+```sh
+python3 build_artifacts.py
+python3 verify_artifacts.py
+sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
+```
+
+默认重算只读取本包压缩的原始记录并生成 CSV、配对明细和静态图，不访问 Engine、Router、Mooncake 或 GPU。绘图使用已有 matplotlib；缺少该库时跳过重画，保留已有图。各运行的 manifest、summary、schedule 原样保存；`raw.jsonl.gz` 使用空 filename、mtime=0 的确定性 gzip。`runs.json` 同时记录未压缩和压缩 SHA256，`SHA256SUMS` 覆盖本包文件。`--repackage --include-host-pressure` 仅用于原采集机重新复制已结束运行，复制前后会检查原文件未变化。

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Offline packaging/analysis only. No service, GPU, or control requests."""
+import argparse, collections, csv, gzip, hashlib, io, json, math, random, shutil, statistics, subprocess, sys
+from pathlib import Path
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+BASE = Path('/tmp/sglang-rfc-build')
+RUNS = ['bench-p2-matrix-v1','bench-p2-ready-window','bench-optimized-matrix-v1','bench-optimized-retention-matrix','bench-optimized-background-v1']
+OPTIONAL = 'bench-optimized-host-pressure-v1'
+OLD = '69de4c3e82494d3aa278b22a067bcfd901cda119'
+NEW = '630da396a576b6bb1dceadbeb0f3442fc33c9f20'
+NEG = {'unused','missing','cancel','route_change'}
+
+def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+def dump(path, value): path.write_text(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2, sort_keys=True)+'\n')
+def gz(data):
+    stream=io.BytesIO()
+    with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=stream,filename='',mode='wb',mtime=0,compresslevel=9) as f: f.write(data)
+    return stream.getvalue()
+def git(*args): return subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(BASE/'runtime-worktree'),*args])
+def quantile(values,p):
+    if not values:return None
+    values=sorted(values); i=(len(values)-1)*p;a=math.floor(i);b=math.ceil(i)
+    return values[a]+(values[b]-values[a])*(i-a)
+def stable_seed(label): return int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(label.encode()).digest()[:8],'little')
+def bootstrap(values,label):
+    if not values:return None
+    seed=stable_seed(label);r=random.Random(seed)
+    samples=[statistics.mean(r.choices(values,k=len(values))) for _ in range(4000)]
+    return {'n_pairs':len(values),'mean':statistics.mean(values),'ci':[quantile(samples,.025),quantile(samples,.975)],'seed':seed,'resamples':4000,'confidence':.95,'method':'percentile bootstrap of paired mean deltas','small_sample':len(values)<20}
+def write_csv(path,rows):
+    if not rows: return
+    with path.open('w',newline='') as f:
+        w=csv.DictWriter(f,fieldnames=list(rows[0]),lineterminator="\n");w.writeheader();w.writerows(rows)

+"""Local JSONL input provenance; user supplied records are never relabelled real."""
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+def sha256(data):
+    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
+
+
+def tokenizer_identity(model):
+    root = Path(model).resolve()
+    files = {}
+    for name in ("config.json", "tokenizer_config.json", "tokenizer.json", "special_tokens_map.json"):
+        path = root/name
+        if path.is_file():
+            files[name] = sha256(path.read_bytes())
+    return {"local_model_path": str(root), "local_tokenizer_path": str(root), "files_sha256": files,
+            "tokenization": "no added special tokens; token arrays used verbatim"}
+
+
+def _tokens(value, label):
+    if not isinstance(value, list) or not value or any(type(x) is not int or not 0 <= x < 2**32 for x in value):
+        raise ValueError(label+" must be a nonempty array of u32 token IDs")
+    return value
+
+
+def load_trace(path, model):
+    """Schema: id, token_prefix|prefix_text, tool_suffix(list|text), tool_wait_s.
+
+    Optional model/tokenizer paths are assertions, and must match local model.
+    declared_origin is provenance from the submitter, never independently verified.
+    """
+    source = Path(path).resolve()
+    raw = source.read_bytes()
+    identity = tokenizer_identity(model)
+    tokenizer, cases, ids = None, [], set()
+    for line_no, line in enumerate(raw.splitlines(), 1):
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        record = json.loads(line)
+        if not isinstance(record, dict):
+            raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} must be an object")
+        case_id = str(record.get("id", f"line-{line_no}"))
+        if not case_id or len(case_id) > 128 or case_id in ids:
+            raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} has invalid/duplicate id")
+        ids.add(case_id)
+        for field in ("model", "tokenizer"):
+            if record.get(field) is not None and Path(record[field]).resolve() != Path(model).resolve():
+                raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} {field} differs from local model/tokenizer")
+        if ("token_prefix" in record) == ("prefix_text" in record):
+            raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} requires exactly one of token_prefix/prefix_text")
+        suffix = record.get("tool_suffix")
+        if not isinstance(suffix, (list, str)):
+            raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} requires tool_suffix token array or text")
+        if "prefix_text" in record or isinstance(suffix, str):
+            if tokenizer is None:
+                from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+                tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
+        prefix = (_tokens(record["token_prefix"], "token_prefix") if "token_prefix" in record
+                  else _tokens(tokenizer.encode(record["prefix_text"], add_special_tokens=False), "encoded prefix"))
+        suffix = (_tokens(suffix, "tool_suffix") if isinstance(suffix, list)
+                  else _tokens(tokenizer.encode(suffix, add_special_tokens=False), "encoded suffix"))
+        wait = record.get("tool_wait_s")
+        if type(wait) not in (float, int) or not 0 <= wait < float("inf"):
+            raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} requires finite nonnegative tool_wait_s")
+        lead = record.get("lead_s")
+        if lead is not None and (type(lead) not in (float, int) or not 0 <= lead < float("inf")):
+            raise ValueError(f"trace line {line_no} invalid lead_s")
+        provenance = {"input_mode": "local_jsonl", "source_file": str(source), "source_file_sha256": sha256(raw),
+                      "source_line": line_no, "source_line_sha256": sha256(line),
+                      "declared_origin": record.get("declared_origin", "user_supplied"),
+                      "origin_independently_verified": False, "model_tokenizer": identity,
+                      "prefix_tokens_sha256": sha256(json.dumps(prefix, separators=(",", ":")).encode()),
+                      "suffix_tokens_sha256": sha256(json.dumps(suffix, separators=(",", ":")).encode())}
+        cases.append({"id": case_id, "prefix": prefix, "suffix": suffix,
+                      "tool_wait_s": float(wait), "lead_s": lead, "provenance": provenance})
+    if not cases:
+        raise ValueError("trace has no input records")
+    return cases
+
+
+def estimate_kv_bytes_per_token(model, override=None):
+    if override is not None:
+        if override <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("KV byte estimate must be positive")
+        return {"bytes_per_token": override, "basis": "explicit_user_estimate", "physical_io_bytes": None}
+    path = Path(model)/"config.json"
+    if not path.is_file():
+        return {"bytes_per_token": None, "basis": "unavailable", "physical_io_bytes": None}
+    c = json.loads(path.read_text())
+    dtype = c.get("torch_dtype", c.get("dtype"))
+    size = {"bfloat16": 2, "float16": 2, "float32": 4}.get(dtype)
+    heads, layers = c.get("num_key_value_heads"), c.get("num_hidden_layers")
+    dim = c.get("head_dim") or (c.get("hidden_size", 0)//c.get("num_attention_heads", 1))
+    supported = size and heads and layers and dim and not c.get("use_sliding_window")
+    return {"bytes_per_token": 2*layers*heads*dim*size if supported else None,
+            "basis": "FULL unquantized K+V model-config estimate" if supported else "unavailable_for_model_layout",
+            "model_config_sha256": sha256(path.read_bytes()), "dtype": dtype, "physical_io_bytes": None}

+"""Opt-in client background inference. No traffic shaping or service mutation."""
+import hashlib
+import threading
+import time
+
+
+class BackgroundLoad:
+    """Closed-loop concurrency; throughput counts only completions in the window.
+
+    Outstanding requests drain after the cutoff and are reported separately.
+    Fresh salts prevent background traffic hitting the foreground target.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, http, tokens, output_tokens, concurrency, trial, seed, salt_namespace=""):
+        self.http, self.tokens, self.output_tokens = http, tokens, output_tokens
+        self.concurrency, self.trial, self.seed = concurrency, trial, seed
+        self.salt_namespace = salt_namespace
+        self.stop_event, self.lock, self.started_event = threading.Event(), threading.Lock(), threading.Event()
+        self.rows, self.threads = [], []
+        self.started_at = self.cutoff = None
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.started_at = time.monotonic()
+        for worker in range(self.concurrency):
+            thread = threading.Thread(target=self._worker, args=(worker,), daemon=True)
+            self.threads.append(thread)
+            thread.start()
+        return self
+
+    def _worker(self, worker):
+        sequence = 0
+        while not self.stop_event.is_set():
+            key = f"{self.trial}:{worker}:{sequence}"
+            sequence += 1
+            salt = "background-"+hashlib.sha256((self.salt_namespace+":"+key).encode()).hexdigest()[:40]
+            row = {"id": key, "started_at": time.monotonic(), "worker": worker}
+            self.started_event.set()
+            try:
+                response = self.http.generate(self.tokens, salt, self.output_tokens,
+                    trial=self.trial, seed=self.seed, origin="background")
+                row.update(success=True, output_tokens=response["meta_info"]["completion_tokens"],
+                           ttft_ms=response["ttft_ms"], latency_ms=response["latency_ms"])
+            except Exception as exc:
+                row.update(success=False, error=f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}", output_tokens=0)
+            row["completed_at"] = time.monotonic()
+            with self.lock:
+                self.rows.append(row)
+
+    def stop(self):
+        if self.cutoff is None:
+            self.cutoff = time.monotonic()
+            self.stop_event.set()
+        for thread in self.threads:
+            thread.join(self.http.timeout*2+5)
+        if any(t.is_alive() for t in self.threads):
+            raise RuntimeError("background request drain remains unknown after bounded timeout")
+        duration = self.cutoff-self.started_at
+        in_window = [x for x in self.rows if x["completed_at"] <= self.cutoff]
+        successful = [x for x in in_window if x["success"]]

+
+def percentile(values, p):
+    if not values:
+        return None
+    values = sorted(values)
+    pos = (len(values)-1)*p
+    lo, hi = math.floor(pos), math.ceil(pos)
+    return values[lo] + (values[hi]-values[lo])*(pos-lo)
+
+
+def distribution(values):
+    return {"n": len(values), "mean": statistics.mean(values) if values else None,
+            **{f"p{round(p*100)}": percentile(values, p) for p in (.5, .95, .99)}}
+
+
+def summarize(records):
+    trials = [x for x in records if x.get("kind") == "trial"]
+    summary = {"attempts": len(trials), "valid_attempts": sum(t.get("valid", False) for t in trials),
+               "failures": [{"trial": t["id"], "group": t["group"], "reasons": t.get("invalid_reasons", [])}
+                            for t in trials if not t.get("valid")], "groups": {}, "paired": {}, "incremental_paired": {}}
+    key = lambda t: json.dumps([t["prefix_tokens"], t["tool_wait_s"], t["lead_s"], t["group"]])
+    for label, grouped in itertools.groupby(sorted(trials, key=key), key=key):
+        rows = list(grouped)
+        resumed = [x for x in rows if x.get("resume")]
+        valid = [x for x in resumed if x.get("valid")]
+        ready = [x for x in resumed if x.get("prefetch_ready_before_resume", x.get("prefetch_ready_by_resume"))]
+        late = [x for x in resumed if x.get("background", {}).get("prefetch") and x not in ready]
+        summary["groups"][label] = {
+            "attempts": len(rows), "valid": len(valid), "completed_resumes": len(resumed),
+            "resumed_ttft_ms": distribution([x["resume"]["ttft_ms"] for x in resumed]),
+            "resumed_latency_ms": distribution([x["resume"]["latency_ms"] for x in resumed]),
+            "complete_cycle_ms": distribution([x["complete_cycle_ms"] for x in resumed if "complete_cycle_ms" in x]),
+            "validated_resumed_ttft_ms": distribution([x["resume"]["ttft_ms"] for x in valid]),
+            "prefetch_ready_before_resume": {"n": len(ready), "ttft_ms": distribution([x["resume"]["ttft_ms"] for x in ready]),

+            "prefetch_not_ready_before_resume": {"n": len(late), "ttft_ms": distribution([x["resume"]["ttft_ms"] for x in late])},
+            "source_computation_ms": distribution([x["source"]["latency_ms"] for x in valid]),
+            "repeated_prefill_tokens": distribution([x["repeated_prefill_tokens"] for x in valid]),
+            "tier_hit_tokens": {tier: sum(x["resume_cache"][tier] for x in valid) for tier in ("device", "cpu", "storage")},

+            "unused_prepared_tokens": sum(x.get("unused_prepared_tokens") or 0 for x in rows),

+    for t in trials:
+        pairs.setdefault(t["pair"], {})[t["group"]] = t
+    deltas = {}

+            continue
+        for group, candidate in members.items():

+            block = deltas.setdefault(label, {"eligible_pairs": 0, "valid_pairs": 0, "completed_pairs": 0,
+                                             "ttft_delta_ms": [], "cycle_delta_ms": [], "validated_ttft_delta_ms": []})
+            block["eligible_pairs"] += 1
+            if base.get("resume") and candidate.get("resume"):
+                block["completed_pairs"] += 1
+                block["ttft_delta_ms"].append(candidate["resume"]["ttft_ms"]-base["resume"]["ttft_ms"])
+                if "complete_cycle_ms" in candidate and "complete_cycle_ms" in base:
+                    block["cycle_delta_ms"].append(candidate["complete_cycle_ms"]-base["complete_cycle_ms"])
+                if base.get("valid") and candidate.get("valid"):
+                    block["valid_pairs"] += 1

+    for label, block in deltas.items():

+                                    "cycle_delta_ms": distribution(block["cycle_delta_ms"]),
+                                    "validated_ttft_delta_ms": distribution(block["validated_ttft_delta_ms"]),

+            block = blocks.setdefault(label, {"eligible_pairs": 0, "completed_pairs": 0, "valid_pairs": 0,
+                                               "ttft": [], "cycle": []})

+             "", "表内延迟包含全部完成的恢复请求，包括控制失败的尝试；valid 列只表示路径与输出校验通过数量。无效路径不可用于证明缓存收益。",
+             "", "| tokens / wait / lead / group | attempts | completed | valid | TTFT p50 ms | p95 ms | cycle p50 ms |",
+             "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |"]

+    for label, group in summary["groups"].items():
+        lines.append(f"| {label} | {group['attempts']} | {group['completed_resumes']} | {group['valid']} | {fmt(group['resumed_ttft_ms']['p50'])} | {fmt(group['resumed_ttft_ms']['p95'])} | {fmt(group['complete_cycle_ms']['p50'])} |")
+    lines += ["", "| paired group | eligible pairs | completed pairs | valid pairs | candidate − on-demand TTFT p50 ms | cycle p50 ms |",
+              "| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |"]
+    for label, pair in summary["paired"].items():
+        lines.append(f"| {label} | {pair['eligible_pairs']} | {pair['completed_pairs']} | {pair['valid_pairs']} | {fmt(pair['ttft_delta_ms']['p50'])} | {fmt(pair['cycle_delta_ms']['p50'])} |")
+    if summary["paired"]:
+        lines += ["", "| paired group | N | mean TTFT delta ms | paired bootstrap 95% CI ms |",
+                  "| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |"]
+        for label, pair in summary["paired"].items():
+            ci = pair["paired_mean_ttft_bootstrap"]
+            interval = "—" if ci["ci"] is None else f"[{fmt(ci['ci'][0])}, {fmt(ci['ci'][1])}]"

+        lines += ["", "bootstrap 对完整配对差值采样；小样本、相关时序与状态变化会限制区间解释。ready 子集只描述已完成准备的样本，全部样本仍保留。"]

+    Path(path, "summary.md").write_text("\n".join(lines))

+"""Small deterministic statistics and causal, client-observed transfer costs."""
+import hashlib
+import math
+import random
+import statistics
+
+
+def quantile(values, p):
+    if not values:
+        return None
+    items = sorted(values)
+    position = (len(items)-1)*p
+    lo, hi = math.floor(position), math.ceil(position)
+    return items[lo] + (items[hi]-items[lo])*(position-lo)
+
+
+def bootstrap_mean_ci(values, *, seed=1729, resamples=4000, confidence=.95):
+    """Resample complete paired deltas, never independently resample each arm."""
+    if not values:
+        return {"n_pairs": 0, "mean": None, "ci": None, "resamples": resamples}
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    estimates = [statistics.mean(rng.choices(values, k=len(values))) for _ in range(resamples)]
+    alpha = (1-confidence)/2
+    return {"n_pairs": len(values), "mean": statistics.mean(values),
+            "ci": [quantile(estimates, alpha), quantile(estimates, 1-alpha)],
+            "confidence": confidence, "resamples": resamples, "seed": seed,
+            "method": "percentile bootstrap of paired mean deltas",
+            "small_sample": len(values) < 20}
+
+
+def stable_seed(label):
+    return int.from_bytes(hashlib.sha256(label.encode()).digest()[:8], "little")
+
+
+class PrefetchCostEMA:
+    """Estimate registration-complete cost; this is not isolated device I/O time.
+
+    Late operations are kept separately because on-demand reads may contend.
+    The prediction only uses already observed, uncontended completions.
+    """
+    def __init__(self, alpha=.25, initial_ms=500, safety=1.5):
+        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in (alpha, initial_ms, safety)) or not 0 < alpha <= 1 or initial_ms <= 0 or safety <= 0:
+            raise ValueError("invalid EMA configuration")
+        self.alpha, self.initial_ms, self.safety = alpha, initial_ms, safety
+        self.states = {}
+
+    def observe(self, key, elapsed_ms, estimated_bytes=None, *, contaminated=False):
+        if not math.isfinite(elapsed_ms) or elapsed_ms < 0:
+            raise ValueError("invalid completion cost")
+        name = str(key) + (":contended" if contaminated else ":uncontended")
+        state = self.states.setdefault(name, {"n": 0, "completion_ms_ema": None,
+                                               "estimated_bytes_ema": None, "estimated_bytes_per_ms_ema": None})
+        state["n"] += 1
+        def update(field, value):
+            if value is not None:
+                old = state[field]
+                state[field] = value if old is None else self.alpha*value+(1-self.alpha)*old
+        update("completion_ms_ema", elapsed_ms)
+        update("estimated_bytes_ema", estimated_bytes)
+        update("estimated_bytes_per_ms_ema", estimated_bytes/elapsed_ms if estimated_bytes and elapsed_ms else None)
+        return dict(state)
+
+    def choose(self, key, available_wait_s, estimated_bytes=None):
+        state = self.states.get(str(key)+":uncontended")
+        predicted = state["completion_ms_ema"] if state else self.initial_ms
+        required = predicted*self.safety
+        return {"lead_s": min(available_wait_s, required/1000), "predicted_completion_ms": predicted,
+                "requested_safety_lead_ms": required, "available_wait_ms": available_wait_s*1000,
+                "window_insufficient": required > available_wait_s*1000,
+                "sample_n": state["n"] if state else 0, "estimate_source": "historical_uncontended_ema" if state else "configured_initial_cost",
+                "estimated_full_kv_bytes": estimated_bytes,
+                "alpha": self.alpha, "safety_factor": self.safety,
+                "physical_io_bytes": None}

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Verify the preserved final-runtime acceptance data without contacting services."""
+import gzip
+import hashlib
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import statistics
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+
+
+def read_json(path):
+    return json.loads(path.read_text())
+
+
+def archive(name):
+    directory = ROOT / name
+    for entry in read_json(directory / "archive.json"):
+        path = directory / entry["file"]
+        data = gzip.decompress(path.read_bytes()) if path.suffix == ".gz" else path.read_bytes()
+        assert len(data) == entry["original_bytes"], path
+        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == entry["original_sha256"], path
+    return directory
+
+
+def trials(name, router=False):
+    directory = archive(name)
+    prefix = "router-" if router else ""
+    kind = "router_trial" if router else "trial"
+    raw = gzip.decompress((directory / f"{prefix}raw.jsonl.gz").read_bytes())
+    rows = [row for line in raw.splitlines() if (row := json.loads(line))["kind"] == kind]
+    summary = read_json(directory / f"{prefix}summary.json")
+    schedule = read_json(directory / f"{prefix}schedule.json")
+    assert len(rows) == len(schedule) == summary["attempts"], name
+    assert len({row["id"] for row in rows}) == len(rows), name
+    assert {row["id"] for row in rows} == {row["id"] for row in schedule}, name
+    assert all(row["valid"] for row in rows), name
+    for group in {row["group"] for row in rows}:
+        members = [row for row in rows if row["group"] == group]
+        if router:
+            expected = summary["groups"][group]["all_completed_ttft_ms"]["mean"]
+            assert abs(statistics.mean(row["resume"]["ttft_ms"] for row in members) - expected) < 1e-7
+        for row in members:
+            hits = row["resume_cache"]
+            assert hits["device"] == 0
+            assert hits["cpu"] + hits["storage"] >= row["prefix_tokens"]
+    return rows, summary
+
+
+def main():
+    pressure, summary = trials("final-host-pressure")
+    assert len(pressure) == 6
+    prepared = [row for row in pressure if row["group"] == "prefetch"]
+    assert len(prepared) == 3
+    assert all(row["prefetch_ready_before_resume"] and row["resume_cache"]["cpu"] == 8192 for row in prepared)

+class Router:
+    def __init__(self, control_http, formal_http, poll_ms=50):
+        self.http, self.formal, self.poll_ms = control_http, formal_http, poll_ms
+        self.capabilities = unwrap(self.http.request("/v1/kv/capabilities"))
+        if not self.capabilities.get("enabled") or self.capabilities.get("lifecycle") != "explicit":
+            raise BenchError("Router explicit lifecycle capability is required")
+
+    def command(self, body, trial):
+        # Retry only a lost transport response, with exactly the same identity.
+        for attempt in range(2):
+            try:
+                return unwrap(self.http.request("/v1/kv/control", body, trial=trial))
+            except BenchError as exc:
+                cause = exc.__cause__
+                if attempt or not isinstance(cause, (OSError, urllib.error.URLError)) or isinstance(cause, urllib.error.HTTPError):
+                    raise
+                self.http.journal.emit("router_transport_retry", trial=trial, command_kind=body.get("kind"))
+
+    def event(self, task, event, revision, event_id, trial, **fields):
+        return self.command({"kind": "session_event", "task": task, "event": event,
+            "revision": revision, "event_id": event_id, **fields}, trial)
+
+    def query(self, task, message_id, trial):
+        return self.command({"kind": "query", "task": task, "message_id": message_id}, trial)
+
+    def topology(self, engines, trial):
+        metrics = self.formal.request("/metrics", trial=trial)
+        if not isinstance(metrics, str):
+            raise BenchError("Router metrics must expose worker health attribution")
+        matches = re.findall(r'^sgl_router_worker_health\{worker_url="([^"\\]+)"\}\s+([01])(?:\.0)?\s*$', metrics, re.M)
+        healthy = {url.rstrip("/") for url, state in matches if state == "1"}
+        if healthy != set(engines):
+            raise BenchError("Router must expose exactly the two expected healthy worker URLs: " + json.dumps(sorted(healthy)))
+        self.http.journal.emit("router_topology", trial=trial, healthy_workers=sorted(healthy),
+                               evidence="Router circuit-breaker health gauge plus Engine capability RPCs")
+        return sorted(healthy)
+
+
+def inspect_preparation(view, b, length):
+    """Validate a frozen logical scope and attributed current Engine observation."""
+    if view.get("state") == "on_demand_fallback":
+        return False
+    if view.get("state") == "unknown":
+        raise BenchError("Router preparation intent became unknown")
+    if view.get("missing_scope") or view.get("materialization_required") or view.get("admission_gaps"):
+        raise BenchError("Router cannot materialize/prepare the frozen full input scope")
+    known = view.get("known_scope", [])
+    if len(known) != 1 or known[0].get("branch") != "main" or known[0].get("end_token") != length:
+        raise BenchError("Router froze a different prefix or branch")
+    operations = view.get("operations", [])
+    if len(operations) != 1:
+        raise BenchError("Router must prepare one exact B-owner operation")
+    op = operations[0]
+    if (op.get("worker_url", "").rstrip("/") != b.http.url or op.get("engine_id") != b.cap["engine_id"]
+            or op.get("owner_epoch") != b.cap["engine_epoch"] or op.get("action") != "sglang.prefetch"):
+        raise BenchError("Router preparation has wrong worker/epoch/action attribution")
+    if op.get("error"):
+        raise BenchError("Router preparation observation failed: " + str(op["error"]))
+    result = op.get("result") or {}
+    status = result.get("update", {}).get("status")
+    if status in ("failed", "rejected", "unsupported", "missing", "deferred", "cancelled", "partial"):
+        raise BenchError("Router child did not complete full preparation: " + str(status))
+    scope = op.get("ready_scope")
+    if scope is None:
+        return False
+    if (scope.get("tier") != "host" or scope.get("provenance") != "engine_scoped_query"
+            or scope.get("start_token") != 0 or type(scope.get("end_token")) is not int
+            or not 0 <= scope["end_token"] <= length):
+        raise BenchError("Router ready scope is not a compatible current host query")
+    return scope["end_token"] == length
+
+
+class PreparationObserver:
+    """Independent lifecycle/RPC thread; the formal-request timer never joins it."""
+    def __init__(self, router, a, b, task, length, deadline, trial):
+        self.router, self.a, self.b, self.task = router, a, b, task
+        self.length, self.deadline, self.trial = length, deadline, trial
+        self.stop_event, self.lock = threading.Event(), threading.Lock()
+        self.view, self.observed_at, self.decision = None, None, None
+        self.error, self.intent_admitted, self.submission_attempted = None, False, False
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True)
+
+    def start(self):
+        self.thread.start()
+        return self
+
+    def run(self):
+        try:
+            remaining = lambda: max(0, round((self.deadline-time.monotonic())*1000))
+            self.router.event(self.task, "tool_wait", 2, "tool-wait", self.trial,
+                target={"kind": "branch", "branch_id": "main", "revision": 1},
+                worker_url=self.a.http.url, pressure=False, expected_wait_ms=remaining())
+            if self.stop_event.is_set():
+                return
+            self.submission_attempted = True
+            view = self.router.event(self.task, "resume_expected", 3, "prepare-b", self.trial,
+                target={"kind": "branch", "branch_id": "main", "revision": 1},
+                worker_url=self.b.http.url, expected_wait_ms=remaining())
+            self.decision = copy.deepcopy(view)
+            if view.get("state") != "on_demand_fallback":
+                self.intent_admitted = True
+            while True:
+                inspect_preparation(view, self.b, self.length)
+                with self.lock:
+                    self.view, self.observed_at = copy.deepcopy(view), time.monotonic()
+                if self.stop_event.wait(self.router.poll_ms/1000) or view.get("state") == "on_demand_fallback":
+                    return
+                view = self.router.query(self.task, "prepare-b", self.trial)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self.error = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+            self.router.http.journal.emit("router_observer_error", trial=self.trial, error=self.error)
+
+    def snapshot(self):
+        with self.lock:
+            return {"view": copy.deepcopy(self.view), "observed_at": self.observed_at,
+                    "error": self.error}
+
+    def stop(self, timeout):
+        self.stop_event.set()
+        self.thread.join(timeout)
+        if self.thread.is_alive():
+            raise BenchError("preparation observer RPC still in flight; cleanup ownership unknown")
+
+
+def flush_local(control, trial, timeout):
+    result = control.http.request("/flush_cache?timeout="+str(timeout), {}, trial=trial)
+    if not isinstance(result, str) or not result.startswith("Cache flushed."):
+        raise BenchError("local flush did not certify success")
+    control.refresh()
+
+
+def assert_cold(control, tokens, salt, trial):
+    target = control.target(tokens, salt)
+    observed = {}
+    for tier in ("gpu", "host"):
+        observed[tier] = control.residency(target, tier, trial)
+        if observed[tier].get("items"):
+            raise BenchError(f"{control.http.url} target is already resident on {tier}")
+    return observed
+
+
+def observed_prepared_tokens(view, length):
+    """Observed lower bound, including historical transfer effects after cancel."""
+    maximum = 0
+    for op in (view or {}).get("operations", []):
+        scope = op.get("ready_scope") or {}
+        if scope.get("tier") == "host" and scope.get("start_token") == 0:
+            maximum = max(maximum, scope.get("end_token", 0))
+        result = op.get("result") or {}
+        public = result.get("public_result") or {}
+        spans = public.get("ready_scope")
+        if spans is None:
+            spans = [x for x in result.get("update", {}).get("target_outcomes", [])
+                     if "destination_ready" in x.get("completed_steps", [])]
+        maximum = max(maximum, intervals_size(spans))
+    if maximum > length:
+        raise BenchError("preparation evidence extends beyond frozen prefix")
+    return maximum
+
+
+def cleanup(router, task, observer, trial, timeout):
+    result = {"state": "unknown", "quiescent": False}
+    try:
+        observer_stopped = True
+        if observer:
+            try:
+                observer.stop(timeout+1)
+            except BenchError as exc:
+                observer_stopped = False
+                result["observer_stop_error"] = str(exc)
+        result["finish_receipt"] = router.event(task, "task_finished", 5, "finish", trial, cascade=False)
+        if observer and observer.submission_attempted and observer.decision is None:
+            # A lost response may still own a job. Query its stable message ID;
+            # unknown remains explicit instead of guessing there was no job.
+            observer.intent_admitted = True
+        if observer and observer.intent_admitted:
+            result["cancel_receipt"] = router.command({"kind": "cancel", "task": task, "message_id": "prepare-b"}, trial)
+            deadline = time.monotonic()+timeout
+            while True:
+                view = router.query(task, "prepare-b", trial)
+                result["last_view"] = view
+                if view.get("quiescent") is True and all(op.get("quiescent") is True for op in view.get("operations", [])):
+                    break
+                if time.monotonic() >= deadline:
+                    raise BenchError("Router cancellation has not drained within cleanup deadline")
+                time.sleep(router.poll_ms/1000)
+            result["ack"] = router.command({"kind": "ack", "task": task, "message_id": "prepare-b"}, trial)
+            if result["ack"].get("acknowledged") is not True:
+                raise BenchError("Router did not acknowledge drained preparation")
+        if not observer_stopped:
+            raise BenchError("observer transport remains in flight after task cleanup; outcome unknown")
+        result.update(state="drained", quiescent=True)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        result["error"] = f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"
+    return result
+
+
+def trial(args, a, b, router, case, spec, journal):
+    row = {"kind": "router_trial", **spec, "valid": False, "invalid_reasons": [], "input_provenance": case["provenance"]}
+    tokens, suffix = case["prefix"], case["suffix"]
+    salt = "router-bench-"+digest([args.run_id, spec["id"]])[:40]
+    task = {"session_id": "bench-"+uuid.uuid4().hex, "incarnation": uuid.uuid4().hex}
+    row.update(task=task, cache_salt=salt, input_case=case["id"], prefix_sha256=digest(tokens), suffix_sha256=digest(suffix))
+    observer, task_started = None, False
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    try:
+        # Flush both owners before source work and A again after confirmed L3
+        # publication. Formal Router selection can then never inherit warm A KV.
+        for engine in (a, b):
+            flush_local(engine, spec["id"], args.timeout_s)
+        row["source_cold"] = assert_cold(a, tokens, salt, spec["id"])
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        row["source"] = a.http.generate(tokens, salt, 1, trial=spec["id"], seed=args.seed, origin="source")
+        source_hits = cache_details(row["source"]["meta_info"])
+        if sum(source_hits[t] for t in ("device", "cpu", "storage")):
+            raise BenchError("source initial computation unexpectedly reused cache")
+        row["publication"] = a.transfer("publish", a.target(tokens, salt), {"tier": "gpu"},
+            {"tier": "storage", "backend": args.storage_backend}, spec["id"])
+        require_completed(row["publication"], len(tokens), "source L3 publication")
+        flush_local(a, spec["id"], args.timeout_s)
+        row["cold_before_preparation"] = {control.http.url: assert_cold(control, tokens, salt, spec["id"]) for control in (a, b)}
+        row["healthy_workers"] = router.topology([a.http.url, b.http.url], spec["id"])
+        row["engine_capabilities_after_flush"] = {"a": copy.deepcopy(a.cap), "b": copy.deepcopy(b.cap)}
+        task_started = True
+        row["task_started"] = router.event(task, "task_started", 0, "start", spec["id"])
+        row["request_observed"] = router.event(task, "request_observed", 1, "observed-source", spec["id"],
+            branch_id="main", branch_revision=1, request_id="source", request_incarnation="source-binding",
+            input_ids=tokens, cache_salt=salt, worker_url=a.http.url)
+        if row["request_observed"].get("state") != "associated":
+            raise BenchError("Router did not associate the exact already-generated source input")
+        wait_started = time.monotonic()
+        deadline = wait_started+spec["tool_wait_s"]

+        observer = PreparationObserver(router, a, b, task, len(tokens), deadline, spec["id"]).start()

+        row["preparation_at_resume"] = observer.snapshot()
+        row["formal_scheduled_monotonic"] = deadline
+        if spec["group"] == "b3_router":
+            context = {**task, "branch_id": "main", "revision": 4, "branch_revision": 2,

+        row["route_changed_from_prepared_b"] = worker != b.http.url
+        row["formal_dispatch_lateness_ms"] = (response["started_monotonic"]-deadline)*1000
+        row["complete_cycle_ms"] = (time.monotonic()-started)*1000
+        row["resume_cache"] = cache_details(response["meta_info"], require=True)
+        hits = row["resume_cache"]
+        if hits["device"] or sum(hits[t] for t in ("cpu", "storage")) < len(tokens):
+            raise BenchError("formal request bypassed verified cold L3/L2 path or recomputed prefix")
+        view = row["preparation_at_resume"]["view"]
+        row["prefetch_ready_before_resume"] = inspect_preparation(view, b, len(tokens)) if view else False
+        if worker == b.http.url and row["prefetch_ready_before_resume"] and hits["cpu"] < len(tokens):
+            raise BenchError("queried B preparation was not reused from host by the actual worker")
+        if worker == a.http.url and (hits["cpu"] or hits["storage"] < len(tokens)):
+            raise BenchError("unprepared A did not prove full ordinary storage reuse")
+        row["repeated_prefill_tokens"] = max(0, len(tokens)-sum(hits[t] for t in ("cpu", "storage")))
+        row["preparation_usage"] = ("unused_on_b_route_changed" if worker != b.http.url else

+        row["valid"] = True
+    except Exception as exc:

+    finally:
+        if task_started:

+            if not row["cleanup"]["quiescent"]:

+        if observer:

+            if observer.error:

+
+
+def report(directory, rows):
+    groups = {}
+    for group in ("b2_direct_b", "b3_router", "route_change"):
+        attempts = [r for r in rows if r["group"] == group]
