+                        timing["completion_elapsed_ms"]]
+                self.command({"kind": "ack", "context": self.context,
+                              "message_id": op["ref"]["message_id"]}, trial)
+                if cancelled_at is not None:
+                    raise BenchError("operation timeout; cancellation drained: " + json.dumps(op))
+                return op
+            if time.perf_counter()-start > self.timeout:
+                if cancelled_at is None:
+                    # Keep cancellation ownership until a quiescent receipt.
+                    op = self.command({"kind": "cancel", "ref": op["ref"]}, trial)
+                    cancelled_at = time.perf_counter()
+                    self.http.journal.emit("control_timeout", trial=trial, cancel=op)
+                    continue
+                if time.perf_counter()-cancelled_at > self.timeout:
+                    self.http.journal.emit("control_drain_unknown", trial=trial, operation=op,
+                                           reason="second bounded cancellation window expired")
+                    raise BenchError("operation timeout; cancellation remains non-quiescent: " + json.dumps(op))
+            time.sleep(self.poll_ms/1000)
+            rpc_started = time.monotonic()
+            reply = self.command({"kind": "query", "context": self.context,
+                                  "message_id": op["ref"]["message_id"]}, trial)
+            matches = [x for x in reply.get("results", []) if x["ref"]["operation_id"] == op["ref"]["operation_id"]]
+            if len(matches) != 1:
+                raise BenchError("query lost operation")
+            op = matches[0]
+            if timing is not None and status(op) in ACTIVE:
+                timing["last_nonterminal_rpc_started_monotonic"] = rpc_started
+
+    def transfer(self, what, target, src, dst, trial, observe=None):
+        action = {"prefetch": "sglang.prefetch", "demote": "sglang.demote", "publish": "sglang.copy_to"}[what]
+        if what == "prefetch":
+            action = self.prefetch_action()
+        elif not self.supports(action, src["tier"], dst["tier"]):
+            raise BenchError(f"capabilities do not advertise {action} on requested path")
+        if what == "publish":
+            paths = self.executor.get("directions", {}).get("copy_to")
+            if paths is not None and [src["tier"], dst["tier"]] not in [list(x) for x in paths]:
+                raise BenchError("capabilities do not advertise executable storage publication")
+        if action == "sglang.copy_to":
+            payload = {"target": target, "src": src, "dst": dst}
+        else:
+            src, dst = copy.deepcopy(src), copy.deepcopy(dst)
+            for location in (src, dst):
+                if location["tier"] == "storage" and self.public.get("backend_namespace_selection"):
+                    location["backend_namespace"] = self.backend_namespace
+            payload = {"target": target, "source": src, "destination": dst,
+                       "allow_partial": False, "timeout_ms": round(self.timeout*1000)}
+        start = time.monotonic()
+        timing = {"started_monotonic": start, "last_nonterminal_rpc_started_monotonic": start,
+                  "definition": "client-observed completion including queue, I/O and host registration; excludes ack; not pure I/O"}
+        op = self.submit(action, payload, trial)
+        timing["submission_returned_monotonic"] = time.monotonic()
+        if observe:
+            observe(op)
+        op = self.wait(op, trial, observe, timing)
+        return {"action": action, "elapsed_ms": (time.monotonic()-start)*1000,
+                "operation": op, "timing": timing, "io_time_ms": None, "physical_io_bytes": None}
+
+    def residency(self, target, tier, trial):
+        return self.command({"kind": "residency", "context": self.context,
+                             "target": target, "location": {"tier": tier}, "limit": 256}, trial)
+
+    def pin(self, target, claim, mode, revision, ttl, trial):
+        payload = {"target": target, "location": {"tier": "host"}, "claim_id": claim,
+                   "mode": mode, "revision": revision, "required_protection": "eviction_exclusion"}
+        if mode != "release":
+            payload["ttl_seconds"] = ttl
+        return self.wait(self.submit("sglang.pin", payload, trial), trial)
+
+    def claim(self, claim_id, trial):
+        return self.command({"kind": "claim", "context": self.context, "claim_id": claim_id}, trial)
+
+
+def sleep_until(deadline):
+    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
+        time.sleep(max(0, min(.05, deadline-time.monotonic())))
+
+
+def require_completed(transfer, expected_tokens, label):
+    op = transfer.get("operation", transfer)
+    if status(op) not in GOOD or not op.get("update", {}).get("quiescent"):
+        raise BenchError(f"{label} did not complete: {json.dumps(op)}")
+    if ready_tokens(op) < expected_tokens:
+        raise BenchError(f"{label} lacks full ready_scope ({ready_tokens(op)}/{expected_tokens})")
+
+
+def require_pin_success(op, expected_tokens, claim_id, owner_epoch):
+    """Protection is independent of transfer readiness; P4b may have no ready_scope."""
+    claim = (op.get("public_result") or {}).get("claim") or {}
+    if (status(op) != "completed" or not op.get("update", {}).get("quiescent")
+            or claim.get("state") != "active" or claim.get("tombstone")
+            or claim.get("claim_id") != claim_id or claim.get("owner_epoch") != owner_epoch
+            or claim.get("effective_protection") != "eviction_exclusion"
+            or not isinstance(claim.get("remaining_ttl"), (int, float))
+            or not math.isfinite(claim["remaining_ttl"]) or claim["remaining_ttl"] <= 0
+            or intervals_size(claim.get("actual_scope", [])) < expected_tokens
+            or (claim.get("location") or {}).get("tier") != "host"):
+        raise BenchError("PIN lacks active, bounded, owner-confirmed protection for full scope: " + json.dumps(op))
+    return claim
+
+
+def require_pin_released(claim, claim_id, owner_epoch):
+    if (claim.get("claim_id") != claim_id or claim.get("owner_epoch") != owner_epoch
+            or claim.get("state") not in ("released", "expired", "invalidated")
+            or not claim.get("tombstone") or claim.get("effective_protection") is not None
+            or (claim.get("remaining_ttl") is not None and claim["remaining_ttl"] > 0)):
+        raise BenchError("PIN release query lacks terminal unprotected claim: " + json.dumps(claim))
+
+
+def apply_host_pressure(args, b, prefix, trial):
+    rows = []
+    count, length = getattr(args, "host_pressure_prefixes", 0), getattr(args, "host_pressure_tokens", 0)
+    if not count or not length:
+        return rows
+    tokens = (prefix*((length+len(prefix)-1)//len(prefix)))[:length]
+    for index in range(count):
+        salt = "pressure-" + digest([args.run_id, trial, index])[:40]
+        row = {"index": index, "tokens": length, "salt": salt}
+        row["generation"] = b.http.generate(tokens, salt, 1, trial=trial, seed=args.seed, origin="host_pressure")
+        target = b.target(tokens, salt)
+        if b.supports("sglang.demote", "gpu", "host"):
+            row["transfer"] = b.transfer("demote", target, {"tier": "gpu"}, {"tier": "host"}, trial)
+            row["mode"] = "demote_to_host"
+        else:
+            row["transfer"] = b.transfer("publish", target, {"tier": "gpu"}, {"tier": "host"}, trial)
+            row["mode"] = "host_copy_with_gpu_residency_possible"
+        require_completed(row["transfer"], length, "host pressure materialization")
+        row["host_residency"] = b.residency(target, "host", trial)
+        row["host_tokens_observed"] = intervals_size([x.get("descriptor", {}) for x in row["host_residency"].get("items", [])])
+        if row["host_tokens_observed"] < length:
+            raise BenchError("host pressure copy was not present at residency observation")
+        rows.append(row)
+    return rows
+
+
+def get_metadata(http):
+    data = {}
+    for name, path in (("model", "/model_info"), ("server", "/server_info"),
+                       ("l3_layout", "/get_hicache_l3_cache_layout")):
+        data[name] = http.request(path, optional=True)
+        if data[name] is None and name in ("model", "server"):
+            data[name] = http.request("/get_" + name + "_info")
+    return data
+
+
+def fingerprint(metadata):
+    info = metadata["server"] or {}
+    args = info.get("server_args", info)
+    output = {k: args.get(k) for k in CAPACITY_KEYS}
+    extra = output.get("hicache_storage_backend_extra_config")
+    if isinstance(extra, str):
+        try:
+            output["hicache_storage_backend_extra_config"] = json.loads(extra)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            pass
+    return output
+
+
+def snapshot(http, trial, phase):
+    try:
+        data = http.request("/metrics", optional=True, trial=trial)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        data = {"unavailable": str(exc)}
+    if isinstance(data, str):
+        data = "\n".join(x for x in data.splitlines()
+                         if not x.startswith("#") and any(k in x.lower() for k in ("hicache", "kv_control", "storage", "prefetch", "cache_host")))
+    http.journal.emit("metrics", trial=trial, phase=phase, url=http.url, metrics=data)
+
+
+def build_tokens(model, length, seed):
+    from transformers import AutoTokenizer
+    tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(model, local_files_only=True, trust_remote_code=False)
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    words = "amber river copper ledger orchard spiral basalt paper window maple vector session cache tool model network number value memory result".split()
+    text = "Read the reference ledger below and answer the question after the tool result.\n"
+    text += "\n".join(f"entry {i}: " + " ".join(rng.choices(words, k=24)) + f" {rng.randrange(1_000_000)}" for i in range(length//10+40))
+    tokens = tokenizer.encode(text, add_special_tokens=False)
+    if len(tokens) < length:
+        raise BenchError("generated token material too short")
+    suffix = tokenizer.encode("\nTool result: all ledger entries are valid. Answer with a short description of the ledger.\nAnswer:", add_special_tokens=False)
+    return tokens[:length], suffix
+
+
+def one_trial(args, a, b, material, spec, journal):
+    trial = {"kind": "trial", **spec, "valid": False, "invalid_reasons": []}
+    prefix, suffix = material
+    salt = "bench-" + digest([args.run_id, args.seed, spec["id"]])[:40]
+    trial.update(cache_salt=salt, prefix_sha256=digest(prefix), resumed_input_tokens=len(prefix)+len(suffix))
+    bytes_per_token = getattr(args, "estimated_kv_bytes_per_token", None)
+    trial["estimated_full_kv_bytes"] = len(prefix)*bytes_per_token if bytes_per_token else None
+    source_target, dest_target = a.target(prefix, salt), b.target(prefix, salt)
+    group = spec["group"]
+    shared, shared_lock = {}, threading.Lock()
+    pin_acquired, future, load = False, None, None
+    executor = concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1)
+
+    def observe(op):
+        with shared_lock:
+            shared["operation"] = copy.deepcopy(op)
+            shared["observed_at"] = time.monotonic()
+            shared.setdefault("first_observed_at", shared["observed_at"])
+            if ready_tokens(op) >= len(prefix) and status(op) == "completed":
+                shared.setdefault("first_ready_observed_at", shared["observed_at"])
+
+    def work(wait_start):
+        data = {}
+        nonlocal pin_acquired
+        if "demote" in group:
+            data["demote"] = a.transfer("demote", source_target, {"tier": "gpu"}, {"tier": "host"}, spec["id"])
+            require_completed(data["demote"], len(prefix), "source demote")
+        if group.startswith("pin_"):
+            # Even a malformed/unknown receipt may have created a bounded claim;
+            # attempt explicit release during cleanup and query its actual state.
+            pin_acquired = True
+            data["pin"] = a.pin(source_target, spec["id"], "acquire", 1,
+                                max(args.pin_ttl_s, spec["tool_wait_s"]+args.timeout_s+5), spec["id"])
+            require_pin_success(data["pin"], len(prefix), spec["id"], a.context["engine_epoch"])
+        if "prefetch" in group or group in NEGATIVES:
+            sleep_until(wait_start + max(0, spec["tool_wait_s"]-spec["lead_s"]))
+            target = copy.deepcopy(dest_target)
+            if group == "missing":
+                target["cache_salt"] += "-missing"
+            if group == "cancel":
+                action = b.prefetch_action()
+                payload = {"target": target}
+                if action == "sglang.prefetch":
+                    location = {"tier": "storage", "backend": args.storage_backend}
+                    if b.public.get("backend_namespace_selection"):
+                        location["backend_namespace"] = b.backend_namespace
+                    payload.update(source=location, destination={"tier": "host"}, allow_partial=False, timeout_ms=round(args.timeout_s*1000))
+                else:
+                    payload.update(src={"tier": "storage", "backend": args.storage_backend}, dst={"tier": "host"})
+                op = b.submit(action, payload, spec["id"])
+                observe(op)
+                cancelled = b.command({"kind": "cancel", "ref": op["ref"]}, spec["id"])
+                data["cancel_receipt"] = cancelled
+                data["prefetch"] = {"action": action, "operation": b.wait(cancelled, spec["id"], observe)}
+            else:
+                data["prefetch"] = b.transfer("prefetch", target,
+                    {"tier": "storage", "backend": args.storage_backend}, {"tier": "host"}, spec["id"], observe)
+        return data
+
+    start = time.monotonic()
+    try:
+        if args.cold_mode == "flush":
+            body = b.http.request("/flush_cache?timeout="+str(args.timeout_s), {}, trial=spec["id"])
+            if not isinstance(body, str) or not body.startswith("Cache flushed."):
+                raise BenchError("flush response did not certify local cache reset")
+            b.refresh()
+            dest_target = b.target(prefix, salt)
+        trial["host_pressure"] = apply_host_pressure(args, b, prefix, spec["id"])
+        # Unique salt also excludes B session/radix content from all previous trials.
+        for tier in ("gpu", "host"):
+            residency = b.residency(dest_target, tier, spec["id"])
+            if residency.get("items"):
+                raise BenchError(f"destination {tier} already contains target")
+        snapshot(b.http, spec["id"], "before")
+        start = time.monotonic()
+        trial["source"] = a.http.generate(prefix, salt, 1, trial=spec["id"], seed=args.seed, origin="source")
+        trial["source_cache"] = cache_details(trial["source"]["meta_info"])
+        if sum(trial["source_cache"][k] for k in ("device", "cpu", "storage")):
+            raise BenchError("source initial computation unexpectedly hit cache")
+        trial["publication"] = a.transfer("publish", source_target,
+            {"tier": "gpu"}, {"tier": "storage", "backend": args.storage_backend}, spec["id"])
+        require_completed(trial["publication"], len(prefix), "storage publication")
+        wait_start = time.monotonic()
+        trial["initial_and_publication_ms"] = (wait_start-start)*1000
+        if getattr(args, "background_concurrency", 0):
+            bg_length = getattr(args, "background_prefix_tokens", 256)
+            bg_tokens = (prefix*((bg_length+len(prefix)-1)//len(prefix)))[:bg_length]
+            load = BackgroundLoad(b.http, bg_tokens, getattr(args, "background_output_tokens", 16),
+                                  args.background_concurrency, spec["id"], args.seed, args.run_id).start()
+        future = executor.submit(work, wait_start)
+        sleep_until(wait_start + spec["tool_wait_s"])
+        trial["actual_tool_wait_ms"] = (time.monotonic()-wait_start)*1000
+        trial["effective_requested_lead_s"] = min(spec["tool_wait_s"], spec["lead_s"])
+        with shared_lock:
+            trial["prefetch_at_resume"] = copy.deepcopy(shared)
+        at_resume = trial["prefetch_at_resume"].get("operation", {})
+        first_observed = trial["prefetch_at_resume"].get("first_observed_at")
+        trial["control_acceptance_lead_ms"] = ((time.monotonic()-first_observed)*1000 if first_observed is not None else None)
+        trial["prefetch_ready_by_resume"] = ready_tokens(at_resume) >= len(prefix) and status(at_resume) == "completed"
+        trial["prefetch_ready_before_resume"] = trial["prefetch_ready_by_resume"]
+        if group not in ("unused", "missing", "cancel"):
+            resume_http = a.http if group == "route_change" else b.http
+            trial["resume"] = resume_http.generate(prefix+suffix, salt, args.output_tokens,
+                                                   trial=spec["id"], seed=args.seed)
+            trial["resume_cache"] = cache_details(trial["resume"]["meta_info"], require=True)
+            hits = trial["resume_cache"]
+            trial["repeated_prefill_tokens"] = max(0, len(prefix)-min(len(prefix), sum(hits[k] for k in ("device", "cpu", "storage"))))
+            if group in ("on_demand", "demote", "pin_demote"):
+                if hits["device"] or hits["cpu"] or hits["storage"] < len(prefix):
+                    trial["invalid_reasons"].append("on-demand baseline did not prove full storage reuse with zero device/CPU hits")
+            elif group != "route_change":
+                if hits["device"]:
+                    trial["invalid_reasons"].append("destination device hit unexpectedly bypassed L3→L2 preparation")
+                if trial["prefetch_ready_by_resume"] and hits["cpu"] < len(prefix):
+                    trial["invalid_reasons"].append("completed prefetch was not reused from CPU/host")
+                if hits["cpu"]+hits["storage"] < len(prefix):
+                    trial["invalid_reasons"].append("resume did not reuse full published prefix")
+        trial["complete_cycle_ms"] = (time.monotonic()-start)*1000
+        if load:
+            trial["background_load"] = load.stop()
+            load = None
+            if trial["background_load"]["total_failures"]:
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("background inference requests failed; configured load was not maintained")
+        trial["background"] = future.result(timeout=args.timeout_s+spec["tool_wait_s"]+2)
+        operation = trial["background"].get("prefetch", {}).get("operation", {})
+        if operation:
+            prepared = ready_tokens(operation)
+            completed_at = trial["background"]["prefetch"].get("timing", {}).get("completion_observed_monotonic")
+            if completed_at is not None and trial.get("resume"):
+                trial["prefetch_ready_before_resume"] = (prepared >= len(prefix) and status(operation) == "completed"
+                    and completed_at <= trial["resume"]["started_monotonic"])
+            if (trial.get("resume") and group not in NEGATIVES and trial["prefetch_ready_before_resume"]
+                    and trial.get("resume_cache", {}).get("cpu", 0) < len(prefix)):
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("completed preparation before actual request send was not fully reused from host")
+            cpu_used = trial.get("resume_cache", {}).get("cpu", 0) if group != "route_change" else 0
+            trial["prepared_tokens"] = prepared
+            # In-flight at arrival is not unused work. Demand/control may share
+            # or race a physical transfer and host attribution alone cannot tell.
+            ambiguous = bool(trial.get("resume") and group != "route_change" and
+                             not trial["prefetch_ready_before_resume"])
+            trial["prefetch_usage_ambiguous"] = ambiguous
+            trial["used_prepared_tokens"] = None if ambiguous else min(prepared, cpu_used)
+            trial["unused_prepared_tokens"] = None if ambiguous else prepared-trial["used_prepared_tokens"]
+            trial["used_prefetch_ratio"] = trial["used_prepared_tokens"]/prepared if prepared and not ambiguous else None
+            trial["prefetch_command_completed"] = status(operation) == "completed"
+            trial["prefetch_outcome_status"] = status(operation)
+            trial["prefetch_attribution"] = ("ambiguous_at_arrival" if ambiguous else
+                "no_resume_or_routed_elsewhere" if group in ("unused", "route_change") else "ready_before_resume_host_reuse")
+            if group not in NEGATIVES and status(operation) != "completed":
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("prefetch control did not complete: " + status(operation))
+            if group == "missing" and (status(operation) not in ("missing", "partial") or prepared):
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("missing-storage negative did not report missing content with zero ready scope")
+            if group == "cancel" and not operation.get("update", {}).get("quiescent"):
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("cancel did not drain")
+            if group == "cancel":
+                trial["cancel_raced_completion"] = status(operation) == "completed"
+        trial["valid"] = not trial["invalid_reasons"]
+    except Exception as exc:
+        trial["invalid_reasons"].append(f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}")
+        trial["exception"] = traceback.format_exc()
+        if future:
+            try:
+                trial["background"] = future.result(timeout=args.timeout_s+spec["tool_wait_s"]+2)
+            except Exception as background_error:
+                trial["background_error"] = str(background_error)
+    finally:
+        executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+        if load:
+            try:
+                trial["background_load"] = load.stop()
+                if trial["background_load"]["total_failures"]:
+                    trial["invalid_reasons"].append("background inference request failures during drain")
+                    trial["valid"] = False
+            except Exception as exc:
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("background drain: " + str(exc))
+                trial["valid"] = False
+        if pin_acquired:
+            try:
+                trial["pin_release"] = a.pin(source_target, spec["id"], "release", 2, None, spec["id"])
+                if status(trial["pin_release"]) != "completed":
+                    trial["invalid_reasons"].append("PIN release failed")
+                    trial["valid"] = False
+                trial["pin_release_claim"] = a.claim(spec["id"], spec["id"])
+                require_pin_released(trial["pin_release_claim"], spec["id"], a.context["engine_epoch"])
+            except Exception as exc:
+                trial["invalid_reasons"].append("PIN release: " + str(exc))
+                trial["valid"] = False
+        snapshot(b.http, spec["id"], "after")
+        trial["quiescent_cycle_ms"] = (time.monotonic()-start)*1000
+    return trial
+
+
+def run(args):
+    output = Path(args.output)
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    journal = Journal(output / "raw.jsonl")
+    try:
+        return run_with_journal(args, output, journal)
+    finally:
+        journal.file.close()
+
+
+def observe_cost_row(costs, cost_key, row, bytes_per_token):
+    if row.get("kind") != "trial":
+        return
+    transfer = row.get("background", {}).get("prefetch", {})
+    operation = transfer.get("operation", {})
+    if status(operation) != "completed" or not operation.get("update", {}).get("quiescent"):
+        return
+    if ready_tokens(operation) < row["prefix_tokens"]:
+        return
+    elapsed = transfer.get("timing", {}).get("completion_elapsed_ms", transfer.get("elapsed_ms"))
+    if elapsed is None:
+        return
+    no_resume = row.get("group") == "unused"
+    ready = row.get("prefetch_ready_before_resume", row.get("prefetch_ready_by_resume", False))
+    costs.observe(cost_key(row["prefix_tokens"]), elapsed,
+        row["prefix_tokens"]*bytes_per_token if bytes_per_token else None,
+        contaminated=bool(row.get("resume") and not ready and not no_resume))
+
+
+def run_with_journal(args, output, journal):
+    args.run_id = args.run_id or uuid.uuid4().hex
+    key = os.environ.get(args.api_key_env) if args.api_key_env else None
+    a_http, b_http = (HTTP(url, journal, args.timeout_s, key) for url in (args.engine_a, args.engine_b))
+    if a_http.url == b_http.url:
+        raise BenchError("source and destination must be distinct engines")
+    meta = {"a": get_metadata(a_http), "b": get_metadata(b_http)}
+    for metadata in meta.values():
+        for field in ("model_path", "tokenizer_path"):
+            observed = (metadata.get("model") or {}).get(field)
+            if observed and Path(observed).resolve() != Path(args.model).resolve():
+                raise BenchError(f"local input {field} differs from serving Engine: {observed}")
+    a, b = (Control(http, "bench-"+args.run_id, args.poll_ms, args.timeout_s) for http in (a_http, b_http))
+    if a.cap["engine_id"] == b.cap["engine_id"]:
+        raise BenchError("engine IDs must differ")
+    for field in ("namespace", "cache_salt_encoding", "weight_version"):
+        if a.cap.get(field) != b.cap.get(field):
+            raise BenchError(f"incompatible source/destination {field}")
+    for field in ("layout_id", "components"):
+        if a.executor.get(field) != b.executor.get(field):
+            raise BenchError(f"incompatible source/destination {field}")
+    if a.backend_namespace != b.backend_namespace:
+        raise BenchError("source/destination backend_namespace differs")
+    differences = {k: [fingerprint(meta["a"])[k], fingerprint(meta["b"])[k]] for k in CAPACITY_KEYS
+                   if fingerprint(meta["a"])[k] != fingerprint(meta["b"])[k]}
+    if differences:

+        op = {"ref": {"context": command["context"], "message_id": env["message_id"],

+def scope(n):
+    return [{"coverage": {"start_token": 0, "end_token": n, "component": "full"}}]

+def operation(n):
+    return {"update": {"status": "completed", "quiescent": True},
+            "public_result": {"ready_scope": scope(n)}}

+class QuietJournal:
+    def emit(self, *args, **kwargs):

+class FakeHTTP:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.journal = QuietJournal()
+        self.url = "mock"
+        self.calls = []
+        self.lock = threading.Lock()
+
+    def generate(self, tokens, salt, count, *, trial, seed, origin):
+        sent = time.monotonic()
+        with self.lock:
+            self.calls.append((origin, salt, sent))
+        return {"ttft_ms": 10, "latency_ms": 20, "started_monotonic": sent,
+                "meta_info": {"completion_tokens": count, "cached_tokens": 64,
+                              "cached_tokens_details": {"device": 0, "host": 64, "storage": 0}},
+                "output_ids": [7]*count, "text": "same"}
+

+class FakeControl:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.http = FakeHTTP()
+        self.context = {"engine_epoch": "epoch"}
+        self.claims = {}
+        self.delay = 0
+        self.fail_pressure = False
+        self.transfers = []
+
+    def target(self, tokens, salt):
+        return {"token_ids": tokens, "cache_salt": salt}
+
+    def transfer(self, what, target, src, dst, trial, observe=None):
+        start = time.monotonic()
+        self.transfers.append((what, src, dst, trial))
+        if self.fail_pressure and "pressure" in trial:
+            raise bench.BenchError("pressure control failed")
+        if what == "prefetch":
+            time.sleep(self.delay)
+        op = operation(len(target["token_ids"]))
+        if observe:
+            observe(op)
+        return {"operation": op, "timing": {"started_monotonic": start,
+                "completion_observed_monotonic": time.monotonic()}}
+
+    def residency(self, target, tier, trial):
+        return {"items": [{"descriptor": {"start_token": 0, "end_token": len(target["token_ids"]), "component": "full"}}]}
+
+    def pin(self, target, claim, mode, revision, ttl, trial):
+        active = mode != "release"
+        result = {"claim_id": claim, "owner_epoch": "epoch", "state": "active" if active else "released",
+                  "tombstone": not active, "effective_protection": "eviction_exclusion" if active else None,
+                  "remaining_ttl": ttl if active else 0, "location": {"tier": "host"},
+                  "actual_scope": scope(len(target["token_ids"]))}
+        self.claims[claim] = result
+        op = operation(0)
+        op["public_result"]["claim"] = result
+        return op
+
+    def claim(self, claim, trial):
+        return self.claims[claim]
+

+# Programmable KV cache
+
+Native KV control implements [RFC #45189](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/issues/45189).
+It is disabled by default. Enabling it executes explicit commands; policies run
+only when listed in the configuration.
+
+## Configuration
+
+```bash
+python -m sglang.launch_server --model-path MODEL_PATH \
+  --kv-control-config '{"namespace":"model-weights-v1","engine_id":"worker-a"}'
+```
+
+The executable profile requires one TP/PP/CP/DP owner, the built-in unified
+cache, and ordinary text generation. Priority control supports FULL, SWA and
+Mamba components through the Python tree backend. Copy and move require FULL
+attention, persistent-host HiCache, and `--disable-overlap-schedule`. Enable
+HiCache with `--enable-hierarchical-cache`; file-backed transfers additionally
+require `--hicache-storage-backend file`.
+
+Remote engines, buffer-only/direct-linker transfers, speculative decoding, PD
+disaggregation, LoRA, multimodal and streaming-session control are unsupported.
+Capability discovery reports the active profile; an unsupported operation does
+not imply successful publication or cache reuse.
+
+Optional local policies can be composed in configuration order:
+
+```json
+{
+  "namespace": "model-weights-v1",
+  "policies": [
+    {
+      "name": "retain",
+      "implementation": "retention",
+      "options": {"priority": 50, "ttl_seconds": 30}
+    },
+    {
+      "name": "capacity",
+      "implementation": "quota",
+      "options": {"borrow_idle_capacity": true}
+    },
+    {
+      "name": "tools",
+      "implementation": "tool_wait",
+      "options": {"tier": "host", "prefetch_on_admission": true}
+    }
+  ]
+}
+```
+
+Retention consumes `importance`/`resume` signals and submits expiring copy
+priorities. Quota provides borrowable session shares with bounded admission
+waiting; native allocation checks still decide whether a request fits.
+Tool-wait coordination considers memory pressure, pause estimates and measured
+transfer cost before moving a prefix. A restored prefix retains an internal
+reference until native request admission takes ownership. An unconfigured
+signal returns `unconsumed`.
+
+## Control API
+
+Use `GET /v1/kv/capabilities` for discovery and `POST /v1/kv/control` for commands.
+The Python engine exposes `kv_control(command)` and `async_kv_control(command)`.
+An inference request can attach the existing `KvHintsEnvelope` through
+`kv_hints`; other consumers' actions remain available to those consumers.
+
+Control commands use `engine_id`, `engine_epoch` and `namespace` from discovery,
+a caller-supplied `caller_id`, and a versioned envelope:
+
+```json
+{
+  "kind": "submit",
+  "context": {
+    "engine_id": "worker-a",
+    "engine_epoch": "EPOCH_FROM_DISCOVERY",
+    "namespace": "model-weights-v1",
+    "caller_id": "router"
+  },
+  "envelope": {
+    "protocol_version": "0.1",
+    "message_id": "retain-prefix-1",
+    "actions": [{
+      "action_id": "keep",
+      "action_type": "sglang.set_priority",
+      "action_version": "1.0",
+      "payload": {
+        "target": {"kind": "tokens", "namespace": "model-weights-v1", "token_ids": [1, 2, 3, 4]},
+        "location": {"tier": "gpu"},
+        "claim_id": "prefix-1",
+        "revision": 1,
+        "value": 90,
+        "ttl_seconds": 30
+      }
+    }]
+  }
+}
+```
+
+| Action | Behavior |
+| --- | --- |
+| `sglang.set_priority` | Apply or clear a signed, expiring priority on existing copies. |
+| `sglang.copy_to` | Publish a destination copy while keeping the source. |
+| `sglang.move_to` | Publish the destination, then reclaim eligible source state. |
+| `sglang.associate` | Associate an append-only continuation with a logical task. |
+| `sglang.finish_task` | Remove task associations and abandon its pending interests. |
+| `sglang.signal` | Offer importance, tool-wait, resume or resume-prediction information to configured policies. |
+
+Targets identify token prefixes, logical content descriptors, or tracked session
+continuations. The attached-request target `"request_cached"` binds only after
+successful completion and cache checkpointing. Cache salt and model/weight
+namespace must match the request that produced the KV.
+
+Priorities are soft: active request/transfer references remain protected, and
+memory pressure can evict any unreferenced copy. Explicit priorities take
+precedence over local policies and session eviction preferences. Expiry, copy
+eviction and cache generation changes end a claim; cache hits do not renew it.
+There is no public pin operation.
+
+Use `query`, `ack` and `cancel` commands with the returned operation references.
+Message replay is idempotent within bounded retention; changed payloads conflict.
+Cancellation drains outstanding worker access before releasing resources.
+`deferred` is a terminal resource refusal and requires a new message ID to retry.
+Task cleanup does not delete shared KV bytes. Weight updates fence inference and
+rotate the lookup namespace before parameter mutation; stale contexts are rejected.

+        self, caller_id: str, *, binding_id: str | None = None
+    ) -> ControlContext:
+        return self.registry.validate_context(
+            ControlContext(
+                engine_id=self.registry.engine_id,
+                engine_epoch=self.registry.engine_epoch,
+                namespace=self.registry.namespace,
+                caller_id=caller_id,
+                binding_id=binding_id,
+            )
+        )
+
+    def _reserve_policy_operations(self, proposals, *, resolutions=None):
+        """Owner-only reservation of a complete plan before any physical effect.
+
+        Each (action_id, primitive) is validated and resolved at this boundary.
+        The owner runtime may retain an already-resolved signal snapshot when a
+        sibling updated history; policies cannot supply authoritative snapshots.
+        Registered children remain queued until the runtime explicitly starts
+        them after dependency/admission checks. Public submit never uses this
+        authority, even with the same caller name.
+        """
+        if not self.enabled or self.executor is None:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Policy execution requires a native owner"
+            )
+        kinds = {SetPriority: "set_priority", CopyTo: "copy_to", MoveTo: "move_to"}
+        if not proposals or len(proposals) > self.limits.max_actions:
+            raise ControlError("capacity", "Policy operation batch exceeds limit")
+        if resolutions is not None and len(resolutions) != len(proposals):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Policy resolutions must match actions"
+            )
+        actions = []
+        for action_id, payload in proposals:
+            if type(payload) not in kinds:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Policy children must be primitives"
+                )
+            actions.append(
+                KvHintAction(
+                    action_id=action_id,
+                    action_type="sglang." + kinds[type(payload)],
+                    action_version="1.0",
+                    payload=msgspec.json.decode(msgspec.json.encode(payload)),
+                )
+            )
+        envelope = KvHintsEnvelope(
+            protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION,
+            message_id="policy-" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
+            actions=actions,
+        )
+        batch, _ = snapshot_envelope(envelope, self.limits)
+        prepared = []
+        for i, frozen in enumerate(batch.actions):
+            payload = parse_action(frozen.thaw())
+            if payload.target == "request_cached":
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Policy children require logical targets"
+                )
+            if payload.target.namespace != self.index.namespace:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "incompatible_namespace", "Policy target namespace differs"
+                )
+            locations = (
+                (payload.location,)
+                if isinstance(payload, SetPriority)
+                else (payload.src, payload.dst)
+            )
+            if any(
+                location.engine_id not in (None, self.registry.engine_id)
+                for location in locations
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "unsupported", "Remote owners approve their own resources"
+                )
+            if not isinstance(payload, SetPriority) and payload.src == payload.dst:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Source and destination must differ"
+                )
+            scope = (
+                self.index.resolve(payload.target)
+                if resolutions is None
+                else validated(resolutions[i], ResolvedTarget)
+            )
+            if (
+                scope.engine_epoch != self.registry.engine_epoch
+                or scope.namespace != self.index.namespace
+                or scope.index_generation > self.index.generation
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "stale_epoch", "Policy snapshot belongs to another owner generation"
+                )
+            prepared.append((payload, scope))
+        submission = self.registry.reserve(batch, self.context("local-policy"))
+        for result, (payload, scope) in zip(submission.results, prepared, strict=True):
+            self._pending[result.ref.operation_id] = _Pending(
+                result.ref, payload, scope, origin="policy"
+            )
+            self.registry.update(
+                result.ref,
+                ExecutionUpdate(
+                    status=Status.QUEUED, quiescent=True, code="policy_dependency"
+                ),
+            )
+        return tuple(result.ref for result in submission.results)
+
+    def _start_policy_operation(self, ref):
+        result = self.registry.get(ref)
+        if result.status.terminal:
+            return result
+        pending = self._pending[ref.operation_id]
+        if pending.origin != "policy":
+            raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Operation has explicit authority")
+        if not pending.started:
+            try:
+                self._start(pending)
+            except ControlError as error:
+                self._error(ref, error)
+        return self.registry.get(ref)
+
+    def submit(
+        self,
+        envelope: KvHintsEnvelope,
+        context: ControlContext,
+        *,
+        execute_primitives: bool = True,
+    ) -> Submission:
+        if type(execute_primitives) is not bool:
+            raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Execution support must be a bool")
+        batch, unhandled = snapshot_envelope(envelope, self.limits)
+        if not batch.actions:
+            return Submission(replayed=False, unhandled_actions=unhandled)
+        submission = self.registry.reserve(batch, context)
+        if submission.replayed:
+            return msgspec.structs.replace(submission, unhandled_actions=unhandled)
+        # Resolve every historical selector against the state at submission,
+        # before any sibling can mutate the index. List order is no dependency API.
+        prepared = []
+        public_payloads = {}
+        for frozen in batch.actions:
+            try:
+                if not self.enabled:
+                    raise ControlError("unsupported", "Native KV control is disabled")
+                if batch.protocol_version != PROTOCOL_VERSION:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "unsupported", "Unsupported native protocol version"
+                    )
+                payload = parse_action(frozen.thaw())
+                if frozen.invalid_numbers:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "invalid_payload",
+                        "JSON numbers must be finite and within the exact integer bound",
+                    )
+                scope = None
+                if isinstance(payload, (Prefetch, Pin)):
+                    public_payloads[frozen.action_id] = payload
+                    if (
+                        payload.target != "request_cached"
+                        and payload.target.namespace != context.namespace
+                    ):
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "incompatible_namespace", "Target namespace differs"
+                        )
+                    if self.executor is None:
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "unsupported", "No cache executor is installed"
+                        )
+                    describe = getattr(self.executor, "capabilities", None)
+                    payload = normalize_public(payload, describe() if describe else {})
+                if hasattr(payload, "target") and payload.target != "request_cached":
+                    if payload.target.namespace != context.namespace:
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "incompatible_namespace", "Target namespace differs"
+                        )
+                if not execute_primitives and (
+                    isinstance(payload, (SetPriority, CopyTo, MoveTo, Pin))
+                    or isinstance(payload, Signal)
+                    and self.policy_runtime is not None
+                    and self.policy_runtime.consumes(payload)
+                ):
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "unsupported",
+                        "This request profile cannot execute native cache operations",
+                    )
+                if (
+                    isinstance(payload, Signal)
+                    and self.policy_runtime is not None
+                    and self.policy_runtime.consumes(payload)
+                ):
+                    scope = self.index.resolve(payload.target)
+                if isinstance(payload, Pin):
+                    if payload.location.engine_id not in (None, context.engine_id):
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "unsupported", "Remote engines approve their own protection"
+                        )
+                    if payload.mode == "acquire":
+                        if payload.target == "request_cached":
+                            if context.binding_id is None:
+                                raise ControlError(
+                                    "invalid_payload",
+                                    "request_cached requires a request incarnation",
+                                )
+                        else:
+                            scope = self.index.resolve(payload.target)
+                if isinstance(payload, (SetPriority, CopyTo, MoveTo)):
+                    locations = (
+                        (payload.location,)
+                        if isinstance(payload, SetPriority)
+                        else (payload.src, payload.dst)
+                    )
+                    if any(
+                        location.engine_id not in (None, context.engine_id)
+                        for location in locations
+                    ):
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "unsupported",
+                            "Remote engines must approve their own resources",
+                        )
+                    if (
+                        isinstance(payload, (CopyTo, MoveTo))
+                        and payload.src == payload.dst
+                    ):
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "invalid_payload", "Source and destination must differ"
+                        )
+                    if payload.target == "request_cached":
+                        if context.binding_id is None:
+                            raise ControlError(
+                                "invalid_payload",
+                                "request_cached requires a request incarnation",
+                            )
+                    else:
+                        scope = self.index.resolve(payload.target)
+                    if self.executor is None:
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "unsupported", "No cache executor is installed"
+                        )
+                prepared.append((payload, scope))
+            except ControlError as error:
+                prepared.append(error)
+        # A finish_task sibling must also see interests whose immutable targets
+        # have been prepared but whose dispatch has not yet been visited.
+        for result, item in zip(submission.results, prepared):
+            if not isinstance(item, ControlError):
+                payload, scope = item
+                if isinstance(payload, (SetPriority, CopyTo, MoveTo)) or (
+                    isinstance(payload, Pin)
+                    and payload.mode == "acquire"
+                    and payload.target == "request_cached"
+                ):
+                    public = public_payloads.get(result.ref.action_id)
+                    self._pending[result.ref.operation_id] = _Pending(
+                        result.ref,
+                        payload,
+                        scope,
+                        deadline=self._clock() + public.timeout_ms / 1000
+                        if isinstance(public, Prefetch)
+                        and public.timeout_ms is not None
+                        else None,
+                    )
+                    if public is not None:
+                        self.registry.set_public_scope(
+                            result.ref,
+                            requested_outcomes(scope) if scope is not None else (),
+                            self.executor.capabilities().get("cache_generation"),
+                        )
+        for result, item in zip(submission.results, prepared):
+            if self.registry.get(result.ref).status.terminal:
+                continue
+            try:
+                if isinstance(item, ControlError):
+                    raise item
+                payload, scope = item
+                self._dispatch(result.ref, payload, scope)
+            except ControlError as error:
+                self._error(result.ref, error)
+        return msgspec.structs.replace(
+            self.registry.query(context, batch.message_id), unhandled_actions=unhandled
+        )
+
+    def _dispatch(self, ref, payload, scope):
+        if isinstance(payload, Pin):
+            if payload.mode == "acquire" and payload.target == "request_cached":
+                key = ref.context.caller_id, ref.context.binding_id
+                self._requests.setdefault(key, set()).add(ref.operation_id)
+                self.registry.update(
+                    ref,
+                    ExecutionUpdate(
+                        status=Status.QUEUED, quiescent=True, code="request_completion"
+                    ),
+                )
+            else:
+                self._execute_pin(ref, payload, scope)
+        elif isinstance(payload, Signal):
+            if self.policy_runtime is not None and self.policy_runtime.consumes(
+                payload
+            ):
+                if scope is None:
+                    raise ControlError(
+                        "invalid_payload", "Signal consumer lacks a submission snapshot"
+                    )
+                if any(
+                    branch.continuation is not None
+                    and self.index.task_identity(branch.continuation.task.session_id)
+                    != branch.continuation.task
+                    for branch in scope.branches
+                ):
+                    self.registry.update(
+                        ref,
+                        ExecutionUpdate(
+                            status=Status.CANCELLED,
+                            quiescent=True,
+                            code="task_finished_before_policy",
+                        ),
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.policy_runtime.on_signal(ref, payload, scope=scope)
+                return
+            # No consumer: do not resolve a session or build observations.
+            self.registry.update(
+                ref,
+                ExecutionUpdate(
+                    status=Status.UNCONSUMED, quiescent=True, code="no_policy"
+                ),
+            )
+        elif isinstance(payload, Associate):
+            record = self.index.associate(payload)
+            if self.association_feedback is not None:
+                self.association_feedback(ref, record)
+            change = LogicalChange(
+                index_generation=self.index.generation,
+                session_revision=self.index.session_revision(payload.session_id),
+                continuation_revision=record.revision,
+                incarnation=record.incarnation,
+            )
+            self.registry.update(
+                ref,
+                ExecutionUpdate(
+                    status=Status.COMPLETED, quiescent=True, logical_change=change
+                ),
+            )
+        elif isinstance(payload, FinishTask):
+            change = self.index.finish_task(
+                payload.session_id, expected_revision=payload.expected_revision
+            )
+            self._cancel_task_interests(change.removed_tasks)
+            cleanup = getattr(self.executor, "release_task_protections", None)
+            if cleanup is not None:
+                cleanup(caller_id=ref.context.caller_id, tasks=change.removed_tasks)
+            if self.policy_runtime is not None:
+                self.policy_runtime.cleanup(change.removed_tasks)
+            self.registry.update(
+                ref,
+                ExecutionUpdate(
+                    status=Status.COMPLETED, quiescent=True, logical_change=change
+                ),
+            )
+        else:
+            pending = self._pending[ref.operation_id]
+            wait = ref.context.binding_id is not None and (
+                payload.target == "request_cached"
+                or isinstance(payload, SetPriority)
+                or payload.src.tier == "gpu"
+            )
+            if wait:
+                key = ref.context.caller_id, ref.context.binding_id
+                self._requests.setdefault(key, set()).add(ref.operation_id)
+                self.registry.update(
+                    ref,
+                    ExecutionUpdate(
+                        status=Status.QUEUED, quiescent=True, code="request_completion"
+                    ),
+                )
+            else:
+                self._start(pending)
+
+    def _execute_pin(self, ref, payload, scope):
+        if (
+            payload.owner_task is not None
+            and payload.mode != "release"
+            and self.index.task_identity(payload.owner_task.session_id)
+            != payload.owner_task
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "stale_revision", "PIN demand owner task is no longer live"
+            )
+        if scope is not None:
+            self.registry.set_public_scope(
+                ref,
+                requested_outcomes(scope),
+                self.executor.capabilities().get("cache_generation"),
+            )
+        update, claim = self.executor.pin(ref=ref, payload=payload, scope=scope)
+        self._finish(ref, update)
+        if claim is not None:
+            self.registry.set_public_claim(ref, claim)
+
+    def _cancel_task_interests(self, removed_tasks: tuple[TaskIdentity, ...]) -> None:
+        removed = frozenset(removed_tasks)
+        for pending in tuple(self._pending.values()):
+            if pending.target is not None and any(
+                branch.continuation is not None and branch.continuation.task in removed
+                for branch in pending.target.branches
+            ):
+                # Content equality alone establishes no task ownership. cancel
+                # retires queued work or asks the executor to drain started work.
+                self.cancel(pending.ref)
+        release = getattr(self.executor, "release_task_preparations", None)
+        if release is not None:
+            release(removed_tasks)
+
+    def request_event(
+        self,
+        context: ControlContext,
+        event: Literal["success", "abort", "error", "preempt", "checkpoint"],
+        *,
+        committed: ContentTarget | TokensTarget | None = None,
+    ) -> tuple[OperationResult, ...]:
+        """success must run before request references are released.
+
+        The owner supplies authoritative committed content for request_cached;
+        its executor acquires separate holds synchronously in start(). This core
+        never observes a live Req or guesses a generated suffix.
+        """
+        self.registry.validate_context(context)
+        if context.binding_id is None or event not in (
+            "success",
+            "abort",
+            "error",
+            "preempt",
+            "checkpoint",
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Expected a request incarnation and lifecycle event"
+            )
+        if event in ("preempt", "checkpoint"):
+            return ()
+        key = context.caller_id, context.binding_id
+        ids = tuple(self._requests.pop(key, ()))
+        results = []
+        for operation_id in ids:
+            pending = self._pending[operation_id]
+            if event != "success":
+                results.append(
+                    self._finish(
+                        pending.ref,
+                        ExecutionUpdate(
+                            status=Status.CANCELLED,
+                            quiescent=True,
+                            code="request_failed",
+                        ),
+                    )
+                )
+                continue
+            try:
+                if pending.target is None:
+                    if committed is None:
+                        raise ControlError(
+                            "missing", "No committed request content supplied"
+                        )
+                    pending.target = self.index.resolve(committed)
+                self._start(pending)
+            except ControlError as error:
+                self._error(pending.ref, error)
+            results.append(self.registry.get(pending.ref))
+        return tuple(results)
+
+    def _start(self, pending):
+        assert self.executor is not None and pending.target is not None
+        if isinstance(pending.payload, Pin):
+            self._execute_pin(pending.ref, pending.payload, pending.target)
+            return
+        if pending.deadline is not None and self._clock() >= pending.deadline:
+            self.cancel(pending.ref)
+            return
+        current = self.registry.get(pending.ref)
+        if (
+            current.public_result is not None
+            and not current.public_result.requested_scope
+        ):
+            self.registry.set_public_scope(
+                pending.ref,
+                requested_outcomes(pending.target),
+                self.executor.capabilities().get("cache_generation"),
+            )
+        if pending.origin == "explicit" and self.policy_runtime is not None:
+            self.policy_runtime.before_explicit(pending.payload, pending.target)
+        if (
+            any(branch.unaligned for branch in pending.target.branches)
+            and not pending.target.allow_clip
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unaligned", "Exact range splits an indivisible descriptor"
+            )
+        pending.started = True
+        try:
+            update = self.executor.start(
+                ExecutionRequest(
+                    ref=pending.ref,
+                    payload=pending.payload,
+                    target=pending.target,
+                    max_result_targets=self.limits.max_scope_spans,
+                    origin=pending.origin,
+                    public_demote=current.action_type == "sglang.demote",
+                )
+            )
+            self._execution_update(pending, update)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self._executor_error(pending, error)
+
+    def _execution_update(self, pending, update):
+        update = validated(update, ExecutionUpdate)
+        current = self.registry.get(pending.ref)
+        if current.status == Status.CANCELLING:
+            update = self._merge_drain_progress(current.update, update)
+        # Validate bounds before retaining a reported failure cause on _Pending.
+        self.registry._validate_update(update)
+        self._validate_execution(pending, update)
+        if update.status == Status.RUNNING and current.status in (
+            Status.RECEIVED,
+            Status.QUEUED,
+        ):
+            self.registry.update(
+                pending.ref, ExecutionUpdate(status=Status.ACCEPTED, quiescent=False)
+            )
+        if current.status == Status.CANCELLING:
+            if update.status == Status.FAILED and pending.failure is None:
+                pending.failure = (update.code, update.reason)
+            update = msgspec.structs.replace(
+                update,
+                status=(Status.FAILED if pending.failure else Status.CANCELLED)
+                if update.status.terminal
+                else Status.CANCELLING,
+            )
+            if pending.failure is not None:
+                update = msgspec.structs.replace(
+                    update, code=pending.failure[0], reason=pending.failure[1]
+                )
+        self._finish(pending.ref, update)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _merge_drain_progress(previous, update):
+        """A drain receipt can omit effects already observed before cancellation."""
+
+        def steps(old, new):
+            return tuple(dict.fromkeys((*old, *new)))
+
+        def target_key(outcome):
+            return (
+                outcome.branch_index,
+                outcome.coverage,
+                outcome.content_id,
+                outcome.location,
+                outcome.coverage_kind,
+                outcome.window_size,
+            )
+
+        outcomes = list(previous.target_outcomes)
+        positions = {target_key(outcome): i for i, outcome in enumerate(outcomes)}
+        for outcome in update.target_outcomes:
+            key = target_key(outcome)
+            position = positions.get(key)
+            if position is not None:
+                old = outcomes[position]
+                if old.completed_steps and not outcome.completed_steps:
+                    continue
+                outcome = msgspec.structs.replace(
+                    outcome,
+                    completed_steps=steps(old.completed_steps, outcome.completed_steps),
+                    status=old.status
+                    if old.status == Status.COMPLETED
+                    else outcome.status,
+                )
+                outcomes[position] = outcome
+            else:
+                positions[key] = len(outcomes)
+                outcomes.append(outcome)
+        # Registry validation still enforces the existing result/step limits.
+        return msgspec.structs.replace(
+            update,
+            completed_steps=steps(previous.completed_steps, update.completed_steps),
+            target_outcomes=tuple(outcomes),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _validate_execution(pending, update):
+        if update.logical_change is not None or update.derived_operations:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_completion",
+                "Executors cannot report logical mutations or create child operations",
+            )
+        payload = pending.payload
+        location = payload.location if isinstance(payload, SetPriority) else payload.dst
+        required = (
+            ("priority_cleared" if payload.value is None else "priority_applied",)
+            if isinstance(payload, SetPriority)
+            else (
+                ("destination_ready", "source_reclaimed")
+                if isinstance(payload, MoveTo)
+                else ("destination_ready",)
+            )
+        )
+        successful = []
+        if "source_reclaimed" in update.completed_steps and (
+            not isinstance(payload, MoveTo)
+            or "destination_ready" not in update.completed_steps
+            or update.completed_steps.index("source_reclaimed")
+            < update.completed_steps.index("destination_ready")
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_completion",
+                "Only MOVE can reclaim a source, after destination publication",
+            )
+        for outcome in update.target_outcomes:
+            if outcome.branch_index >= len(pending.target.branches):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_completion", "Unknown snapshot branch in result"
+                )
+            if not outcome.completed_steps:
+                continue
+            if "source_reclaimed" in outcome.completed_steps and (
+                not isinstance(payload, MoveTo)
+                or "destination_ready" not in outcome.completed_steps
+                or outcome.completed_steps.index("source_reclaimed")
+                < outcome.completed_steps.index("destination_ready")
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_completion",
+                    "Source reclamation requires destination publication",
+                )
+            coverage = outcome.coverage
+            actual = outcome.location
+            if (
+                actual is None
+                or actual.tier != location.tier
+                or actual.engine_id not in (None, pending.ref.context.engine_id)
+                or (location.backend is not None and actual.backend != location.backend)
+                or (
+                    location.backend_namespace is not None
+                    and actual.backend_namespace != location.backend_namespace
+                )
+                or coverage.component is None
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_completion",
+                    "Actual coverage must identify the requested location and component",
+                )
+            in_scope = False
+            for branch in (pending.target.branches[outcome.branch_index],):
+                if isinstance(branch.content, TokensTarget):
+                    in_scope |= (
+                        branch.requested.start_token
+                        <= coverage.start_token
+                        <= coverage.end_token
+                        <= min(
+                            branch.requested.end_token, len(branch.content.token_ids)
+                        )
+                        and (
+                            outcome.coverage_kind != "checkpoint"
+                            or coverage.end_token > branch.requested.start_token
+                        )
+                    )
+                else:
+                    in_scope |= any(
+                        span.component == coverage.component
+                        and span.content_id == outcome.content_id
+                        and span.coverage_kind == outcome.coverage_kind
+                        and span.window_size == outcome.window_size
+                        and span.start_token
+                        <= coverage.start_token
+                        <= coverage.end_token
+                        <= span.end_token
+                        for span in branch.spans
+                    )
+            if not in_scope:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_completion", "Actual coverage exceeds the bound target"
+                )
+            successful.append(outcome)
+        if update.status != Status.COMPLETED:
+            return
+        if not successful or not set(required).issubset(update.completed_steps):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_completion",
+                "Completed primitive needs actual coverage and completed stages",
+            )
+        if any(
+            branch.missing or branch.unaligned for branch in pending.target.branches
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_completion",
+                "Incomplete logical coverage must be reported as partial",
+            )
+        complete = [
+            outcome
+            for outcome in successful
+            if outcome.status == Status.COMPLETED
+            and set(required).issubset(outcome.completed_steps)
+        ]
+
+        def covers(branch_index, component, content_id, start, end):
+            intervals = sorted(
+                (o.coverage.start_token, o.coverage.end_token)
+                for o in complete
+                if o.branch_index == branch_index
+                and o.coverage.component == component
+                and (content_id is None or o.content_id == content_id)
+            )
+            if start == end:
+                return (start, end) in intervals
+            cursor = start
+            for left, right in intervals:
+                if left > cursor:
+                    break
+                cursor = max(cursor, right)
+            return cursor >= end
+
+        for branch_index, branch in enumerate(pending.target.branches):
+            if isinstance(branch.content, TokensTarget):
+                # The executor certifies its required layout. Tokens alone do
+                # not enumerate components, but each reported one must be whole.
+                components = {
+                    outcome.coverage.component
+                    for outcome in complete
+                    if outcome.branch_index == branch_index
+                }
+                covered = bool(components)
+                for component in components:
+                    members = [
+                        o
+                        for o in complete
+                        if o.branch_index == branch_index
+                        and o.coverage.component == component
+                    ]
+                    kinds = {(o.coverage_kind, o.window_size) for o in members}
+                    if len(kinds) != 1:
+                        covered = False
+                        break
+                    kind, window = kinds.pop()
+                    start, end = (
+                        branch.requested.start_token,
+                        branch.requested.end_token,
+                    )
+                    if kind == "checkpoint":
+                        start = end
+                    elif kind == "window":
+                        start = max(start, end - window)
+                    covered &= covers(branch_index, component, None, start, end)
+            else:
+                covered = bool(branch.spans) and all(
+                    covers(
+                        branch_index,
+                        span.component,
+                        span.content_id,
+                        span.start_token,
+                        span.end_token,
+                    )
+                    for span in branch.spans
+                )
+            if not covered:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_completion",
+                    "Completed result omits required logical coverage",
+                )
+
+    def _finish(self, ref, update):
+        result = self.registry.update(ref, update)
+        if result.status.terminal:
+            self._pending.pop(ref.operation_id, None)
+            key = ref.context.caller_id, ref.context.binding_id
+            ids = self._requests.get(key)
+            if ids is not None:
+                ids.discard(ref.operation_id)
+                if not ids:
+                    del self._requests[key]
+        return result
+
+    def _error(self, ref, error):
+        status = (
+            Status.UNSUPPORTED
+            if error.code in ("unsupported", "unaligned")
+            else (Status.MISSING if error.code == "missing" else Status.REJECTED)
+        )
+        return self._finish(
+            ref,
+            ExecutionUpdate(
+                status=status, quiescent=True, code=error.code, reason=str(error)[:4096]
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def _executor_error(self, pending, error):
+        current = self.registry.get(pending.ref)
+        if pending.failure is None:
+            pending.failure = (
+                "executor_error",
+                f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}"[:4096],
+            )
+        update = msgspec.structs.replace(
+            current.update,
+            status=Status.CANCELLING,
+            quiescent=False,
+            code=pending.failure[0],
+            reason=pending.failure[1],
+        )
+        self.registry.update(pending.ref, update)
+
+    def cancel(self, ref: OperationRef) -> OperationResult:
+        current = self.registry.get(ref)  # Includes expected incarnation check.
+        if current.status.terminal:
+            return current
+        pending = self._pending[ref.operation_id]
+        if not pending.started:
+            return self._finish(
+                ref,
+                ExecutionUpdate(
+                    status=Status.CANCELLED,
+                    quiescent=True,
+                    code="cancelled_before_dispatch",
+                ),
+            )
+        if pending.cancel_sent:
+            return current
+        if current.status != Status.CANCELLING:
+            self.registry.update(
+                ref,
+                msgspec.structs.replace(
+                    current.update, status=Status.CANCELLING, quiescent=False
+                ),
+            )
+        pending.cancel_sent = True
+        try:
+            update = self.executor.cancel(ref)
+            if update is not None:
+                self._execution_update(pending, update)
+        except Exception as error:
+            self._executor_error(pending, error)
+        return self.registry.get(ref)
+
+    def progress(self, *, limit: int = 64) -> tuple[OperationResult, ...]:
+        if type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= 4096:
+            raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Progress batch exceeds limit")
+        if (
+            self._pending
+            and (begin_poll := getattr(self.executor, "begin_poll", None)) is not None
+        ):
+            try:
+                begin_poll(limit=limit)
+            except Exception as error:
+                for pending in tuple(self._pending.values()):
+                    if pending.started:
+                        self._executor_error(pending, error)
+        results = []
+        # Rotate polled entries for bounded fair progress, including idle serving.
+        for operation_id in tuple(self._pending):
+            pending = self._pending[operation_id]
+            if pending.deadline is not None and self._clock() >= pending.deadline:
+                self.cancel(pending.ref)
+                if operation_id not in self._pending:
+                    results.append(self.registry.get(pending.ref))
+                    if len(results) >= limit:
+                        break
+                    continue
+            if not pending.started:
+                continue
+            self._pending.pop(operation_id)
+            self._pending[operation_id] = pending
+            try:
+                if (
+                    self.registry.get(pending.ref).status == Status.CANCELLING
+                    and not pending.cancel_sent
+                ):
+                    self.cancel(pending.ref)
+                if operation_id in self._pending:
+                    update = self.executor.poll(pending.ref)
+                    if update is not None:
+                        self._execution_update(pending, update)
+            except Exception as error:
+                self._executor_error(pending, error)
+            results.append(self.registry.get(pending.ref))
+            if len(results) >= limit:
+                break
+        return tuple(results)
+
+    def reset(self, namespace: str) -> None:
+        """Rotate logical generation after the owner has drained/reset real caches."""
+        if self.registry.capacity()["active"]:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "busy", "Drain active operations before rotating the epoch"
+            )
+        registry = OperationRegistry(
+            self.registry.engine_id, namespace, limits=self.limits, clock=self._clock
+        )
+        index = LogicalIndex(namespace, registry.engine_epoch, limits=self.limits)
+        self.registry, self.index = registry, index
