+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Bounded, owner-thread polling feedback; never sent on the KV location socket."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import threading
+import time
+import uuid
+from collections import deque
+from typing import Annotated, Literal
+
+import msgspec
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.contracts import (
+    CacheWatermark,
+    ControlContext,
+    ControlError,
+    Identifier,
+    OperationResult,
+    Position,
+    Status,
+    TokensTarget,
+    Value,
+)
+
+
+class FeedbackLimits(Value):
+    max_events: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=65536)] = 4096
+    max_bytes: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1024, le=1 << 28)] = 8 << 20
+    max_event_bytes: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1024, le=1 << 24)] = 1 << 20
+    max_requests: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=65536)] = 4096
+
+
+class FeedbackPublisherConfig(Value):
+    # Always bind: accidentally connecting this channel to a legacy PUB/SUB
+    # endpoint would expose unknown control events to old subscribers.
+    endpoint: Identifier
+    replay_endpoint: Identifier | None = None
+    buffer_steps: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=4096)] = 256
+    max_queue_size: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=1024)] = 32
+    hwm: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=4096)] = 256
+
+
+class ControlEventBatch(msgspec.Struct, kw_only=True):
+    source_id: str
+    source_epoch: str
+    engine_id: str
+    engine_epoch: str
+    namespace: str
+    events: tuple[ControlEvent, ...]
+    earliest_sequence: int
+    latest_sequence: int
+    gap: bool
+    version: Literal["1.0"] = "1.0"
+    attn_dp_rank: int | None = None
+
+
+class FeedbackCursor(Value):
+    source_id: Identifier
+    source_epoch: Identifier
+    sequence: Position
+
+
+class RequestAssociation(Value):
+    """Explicit application provenance, not authority to modify Engine sessions."""
+
+    request_id: Identifier | None = None
+    session_id: Identifier | None = None
+    session_incarnation: Identifier | None = None
+    branch_id: Identifier | None = None
+    branch_revision: Position | None = None
+
+
+class RequestUse(Value):
+    context: ControlContext
+    request_id: str
+    association: RequestAssociation | None
+    association_state: Literal["provided", "unknown"]
+    cached_tokens: Position
+    device_tokens: Position | None
+    host_tokens: Position | None
+    storage_tokens: Position | None
+    tier_accounting: Literal["measured", "unknown"]
+    checkpointed: bool
+    checkpointed_tokens: Position
+    aborted: bool
+    committed_prefix: TokensTarget | None
+    # Completion is a request fact; it never implies task/session completion.
+    provenance: Literal["engine_request_accounting"] = "engine_request_accounting"
+
+
+class ControlEvent(Value):
+    sequence: Position
+    kind: Literal["operation", "association", "request_use", "claim", "invalidation"]
+    caller_id: Identifier | None
+    cache_watermark: CacheWatermark
+    # Private JSON snapshot: journal size includes every byte of this payload.
+    payload: dict
+
+
+class FeedbackPage(Value):
+    source_id: Identifier
+    source_epoch: Identifier
+    engine_id: Identifier
+    engine_epoch: Identifier
+    namespace: Identifier
+    items: tuple[ControlEvent, ...]
+    next_cursor: FeedbackCursor
+    gap: bool
+    earliest_sequence: Position
+    latest_sequence: Position
+    cache_watermark: CacheWatermark
+    recovery: Literal["query_known_scopes"] = "query_known_scopes"
+
+
+class FeedbackJournal:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        engine_id,
+        engine_epoch,
+        namespace,
+        limits,
+        watermark,
+        publisher_config=None,
+        clock=time.monotonic,
+    ):
+        self.engine_id, self.engine_epoch, self.namespace = (
+            engine_id,
+            engine_epoch,
+            namespace,
+        )
+        self.source_id, self.source_epoch = (
+            "control:" + hashlib.sha256(engine_id.encode()).hexdigest(),
+            uuid.uuid4().hex,
+        )
+        self._thread = threading.get_ident()
+        self.limits, self.watermark = limits, watermark
+        self._events: deque[tuple[ControlEvent, int]] = deque()
+        self._bytes, self._sequence = 0, 0
+        self._requests: dict[
+            tuple[str, str], tuple[str, RequestAssociation | None]
+        ] = {}
+        self.publisher = None
+        self._published = 0
+        self.publisher_config = publisher_config
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._publish_retry_at = 0.0
+        if publisher_config is not None:
+            from sglang.srt.disaggregation.kv_events import EventPublisherFactory
+
+            if publisher_config.endpoint == publisher_config.replay_endpoint:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_payload", "Control PUB and replay endpoints must differ"
+                )
+            config = {
+                "publisher": "zmq",
+                "bind": True,
+                "topic": "sglang.control.v1",
+                **msgspec.to_builtins(publisher_config),
+            }
+            self.publisher = EventPublisherFactory.create(
+                msgspec.json.encode(config).decode()
+            )
+
+    @property
+    def has_outbox(self):
+        return self.publisher is not None and self._published < self._sequence
+
+    @property
+    def next_deadline(self):
+        return max(self._clock(), self._publish_retry_at) if self.has_outbox else None
+
+    def flush(self, *, limit=64):
+        self._owner()
+        if not self.has_outbox or self._clock() < self._publish_retry_at:
+            return
+        earliest = self._events[0][0].sequence if self._events else self._sequence + 1
+        selected, size = [], 0
+        for event, event_size in self._events:
+            if event.sequence <= self._published:
+                continue
+            if selected and (
+                len(selected) >= limit
+                or size + event_size > self.limits.max_event_bytes
+            ):
+                break
+            selected.append(event)
+            size += event_size
+        events = tuple(selected)
+        latest = events[-1].sequence if events else self._sequence
+        batch = ControlEventBatch(
+            source_id=self.source_id,
+            source_epoch=self.source_epoch,
+            engine_id=self.engine_id,
+            engine_epoch=self.engine_epoch,
+            namespace=self.namespace,
+            events=events,
+            earliest_sequence=earliest,
+            latest_sequence=latest,
+            gap=self._published < earliest - 1,
+        )
+        if self.publisher.try_publish(batch):
+            self._published = latest
+            self._publish_retry_at = 0.0
+        else:
+            self._publish_retry_at = self._clock() + 0.01
+
+    def describe(self):
+        source = (
+            self.publisher.describe_local_source(0)
+            if self.publisher is not None
+            else None
+        )
+        return {
+            "query": "events",
+            "version": "1.0",
+            "publisher": self.publisher is not None,
+            "source_id": self.source_id,
+            "source_epoch": self.source_epoch,
+            "endpoint": source["endpoint"]
+            if source is not None
+            else (
+                self.publisher_config.endpoint if self.publisher is not None else None
+            ),
+            "replay_endpoint": source.get("replay_endpoint")
+            if source is not None
+            else (
+                self.publisher_config.replay_endpoint
+                if self.publisher is not None
+                else None
+            ),
+            "topic": "sglang.control.v1" if self.publisher is not None else None,
+            "transport_sequence": "separate_frame_sequence",
+            "cursor_sequence": "ControlEvent.sequence",
+            "recovery": "query_known_scopes",
+            "request_association": "bind_request_optional_provenance",
+            "limits": self.limits,
+        }
+
+    def close(self):
+        if self.publisher is not None:
+            self.flush()
+            self.publisher.shutdown()
+            self.publisher = None
+
+    def append(self, kind, caller_id, payload):
+        self._owner()
+        # A dropped/oversized event consumes a sequence. Polling surfaces a gap
+        # instead of claiming that the absent effect did not happen.
+        self._sequence += 1
+        encoded = msgspec.json.encode(payload)
+        if len(encoded) > self.limits.max_event_bytes:
+            self._events.clear()
+            self._bytes = 0
+            return
+        event = ControlEvent(
+            sequence=self._sequence,
+            kind=kind,
+            caller_id=caller_id,
+            cache_watermark=self.watermark(),
+            payload=msgspec.json.decode(encoded),
+        )
+        size = len(msgspec.json.encode(event))
+        if size > min(self.limits.max_bytes, self.limits.max_event_bytes):
+            self._events.clear()
+            self._bytes = 0
+            return
+        self._events.append((event, size))
+        self._bytes += size
+        while (
+            len(self._events) > self.limits.max_events
+            or self._bytes > self.limits.max_bytes
+        ):
+            _, removed = self._events.popleft()
+            self._bytes -= removed
+
+    def operation(self, result: OperationResult):
+        # A synchronous PIN attaches its claim receipt immediately after its
+        # terminal update. Publish that complete receipt once, not an earlier
+        # terminal snapshot with its claim temporarily absent.
+        if (
+            result.action_type == "sglang.pin"
+            and result.status == Status.COMPLETED
+            and (result.public_result is None or result.public_result.claim is None)
+        ):
+            return
+        self.append("operation", result.ref.context.caller_id, result)
+        if result.public_result is not None and result.public_result.claim is not None:
+            self.append(
+                "claim", result.ref.context.caller_id, result.public_result.claim
+            )
+        if (
+            result.update.logical_change is not None
+            and result.update.logical_change.removed_tasks
+        ):
+            self.append(
+                "association",
+                result.ref.context.caller_id,
+                {
+                    "operation_ref": result.ref,
+                    "change": result.update.logical_change,
+                    "association_state": "local_index_change",
+                },
+            )
+
+    def register_request(self, context, request_id):
+        self._owner()
+        key = context.caller_id, context.binding_id
+        if (
+            key not in self._requests
+            and len(self._requests) >= self.limits.max_requests
+        ):
+            self.append(
+                "invalidation",
+                context.caller_id,
+                {"reason": "request_feedback_capacity", "request_binding": context},
+            )
+            return
+        self._requests[key] = request_id, None
+        self.append(
+            "association",
+            context.caller_id,
+            {
+                "context": context,
+                "request_id": request_id,
+                "association_state": "unknown",
+                "association": None,
+            },
+        )
+
+    def association(self, ref, record):
+        self.append(
+            "association",
+            ref.context.caller_id,
+            {
+                "operation_ref": ref,
+                "continuation": record,
+                "association_state": "local_index_record",
+            },
+        )
+
+    def bind_request(self, context, binding_id, association):
+        self._owner()
+        key = context.caller_id, binding_id
+        if key not in self._requests:
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Request binding is not live for this caller")
+        request_id, previous = self._requests[key]
+        if previous is not None and previous != association:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "conflict", "Request binding already has different explicit provenance"
+            )
+        if previous is None:
+            self._requests[key] = request_id, association
+            self.append(
+                "association",
+                context.caller_id,
+                {
+                    "binding_id": binding_id,
+                    "association": association,
+                    "association_state": "provided",
+                },
+            )
+        return association
+
+    def finish_request(
+        self, context, req, *, checkpointed, aborted, committed, committed_tokens
+    ):
+        self._owner()
+        tracked = self._requests.pop((context.caller_id, context.binding_id), None)
+        if tracked is None:
+            return
+        request_id, association = tracked
+        measured = req._cache_breakdown_computed
+        use = RequestUse(
+            context=context,
+            request_id=request_id,
+            association=association,
+            association_state="provided" if association is not None else "unknown",
+            cached_tokens=max(0, req.cached_tokens),
+            device_tokens=req.cached_tokens_device if measured else None,
+            host_tokens=req.cached_tokens_host if measured else None,
+            storage_tokens=req.cached_tokens_storage if measured else None,
+            tier_accounting="measured" if measured else "unknown",
+            checkpointed=checkpointed,
+            checkpointed_tokens=committed_tokens if checkpointed else 0,
+            aborted=aborted,
+            committed_prefix=committed,
+        )
+        self.append("request_use", context.caller_id, use)
+
+    def query(self, *, caller_id, cursor, limit):
+        self._owner()
+        earliest = self._events[0][0].sequence if self._events else self._sequence + 1
+        mismatch = cursor is not None and (
+            cursor.source_id != self.source_id
+            or cursor.source_epoch != self.source_epoch
+        )
+        after = 0 if cursor is None or mismatch else cursor.sequence
+        if after > self._sequence:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Feedback cursor exceeds this source watermark"
+            )
+        items = tuple(
+            e
+            for e, _ in self._events
+            if e.sequence > after and e.caller_id in (None, caller_id)
+        )[:limit]
+        sequence = items[-1].sequence if len(items) == limit else self._sequence
+        return FeedbackPage(
+            source_id=self.source_id,
+            source_epoch=self.source_epoch,
+            engine_id=self.engine_id,
+            engine_epoch=self.engine_epoch,
+            namespace=self.namespace,
+            items=items,
+            next_cursor=FeedbackCursor(
+                source_id=self.source_id,
+                source_epoch=self.source_epoch,
+                sequence=sequence,
+            ),
+            gap=mismatch or after < earliest - 1,
+            earliest_sequence=earliest,
+            latest_sequence=self._sequence,
+            cache_watermark=self.watermark(),
+        )
+
+    def _owner(self):
+        if threading.get_ident() != self._thread:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "wrong_owner", "Feedback is owned by the scheduler thread"
+            )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""HTTP facade for the same typed scheduler control service used by Engine."""
+
+from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
+
+from sglang.srt.utils.auth import AuthLevel, auth_level
+
+
+def install_routes(app, get_manager):
+    async def send(command):
+        reply = await get_manager().kv_control(command)
+        code = reply.get("error", {}).get("code")
+        status = (
+            200
+            if reply["success"]
+            else {
+                "unsupported": 503,
+                "unavailable": 503,
+                "capacity": 429,
+                "missing": 404,
+                "conflict": 409,
+                "stale_epoch": 409,
+                "wrong_engine": 409,
+                "incompatible_namespace": 409,
+                "busy": 409,
+            }.get(code, 400)
+        )
+        return JSONResponse(reply, status_code=status)
+
+    @app.get("/v1/kv/capabilities")
+    @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL)
+    async def capabilities():
+        return await send({"kind": "capabilities"})
+
+    @app.post("/v1/kv/control")
+    @auth_level(AuthLevel.ADMIN_OPTIONAL)
+    async def control(command: dict):
+        return await send(command)

+"""Bounded logical relationships. No method asserts physical residency."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import msgspec
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.contracts import (
+    Associate,
+    CacheCompatibility,
+    ContentSpan,
+    ContentTarget,
+    ControlError,

+    Limits,
+    LogicalChange,
+    LogicalTarget,
+    ParentPrefix,
+    Position,
+    SessionTarget,
+    TaskIdentity,
+    TokenRange,
+    TokensTarget,
+    Value,
+    cache_compatibility,
+    validate_target,
+    validated,
+)
+

+    task: TaskIdentity
+    continuation_id: str
+    revision: int
+    incarnation: int
+    content: ContentTarget | TokensTarget
+    parent_prefix: ParentPrefix | None = None
+
+
+class RangeGap(Value):

+    reason: str
+
+

+    continuation: Continuation | None
+    content: ContentTarget | TokensTarget
+    requested: TokenRange
+    spans: tuple[ContentSpan, ...]

+    missing: tuple[RangeGap, ...]
+    dependencies: tuple[TokenRange, ...]

+
+class ResolvedTarget(Value):
+    engine_epoch: str
+    namespace: str
+    index_generation: int
+    allow_clip: bool
+    branches: tuple[ResolvedBranch, ...]
+
+
+class IndexCursor(Value):
+    engine_epoch: Identifier
+    namespace: Identifier
+    generation: Position
+    session_id: Identifier | None
+    after: tuple[Identifier, Identifier]
+
+
+class AssociationPage(Value):
+    engine_epoch: str
+    namespace: str
+    generation: int
+    items: tuple[Continuation, ...]
+    session_revisions: tuple[tuple[str, int], ...]
+    next_cursor: IndexCursor | None
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _Session:
+    identity: TaskIdentity
+    revision: int
+    parent_id: str | None
+    continuations: set[str]
+    children: set[str]
+
+
+def _length(content):
+    return (
+        len(content.token_ids)
+        if isinstance(content, TokensTarget)
+        else content.token_count
+    )
+
+
+def _sizes(content):
+    return (
+        (0, len(content.token_ids))
+        if isinstance(content, TokensTarget)
+        else (len(content.spans), 0)
+    )
+
+
+class LogicalIndex:
+    """One owner-thread index with immutable, independently usable snapshots.
+
+    Revision/incarnation numbers never repeat within this epoch. Failed updates
+    change neither generations nor reverse memberships. Capacity is refused;
+    history is only forgotten through explicit prune/finish operations.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, namespace: str, engine_epoch: str, *, limits: Limits = Limits()):
+        self.namespace = validated(namespace, Identifier)
+        self.engine_epoch = validated(engine_epoch, Identifier)
+        self.limits = limits
+        self.generation = 0
+        self._sessions: dict[str, _Session] = {}
+        self._continuations: dict[tuple[str, str], Continuation] = {}
+        self._members: dict[
+            tuple[CacheCompatibility, ContentSpan], set[tuple[str, str]]
+        ] = {}
+        self._spans = 0
+        self._tokens = 0
+
+    def get(self, session_id: str, continuation_id: str) -> Continuation:
+        validated(session_id, Identifier)
+        validated(continuation_id, Identifier)
+        record = self._continuations.get((session_id, continuation_id))
+        if record is None:
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Continuation is not tracked")
+        return record
+
+    def session_revision(self, session_id: str) -> int:
+        validated(session_id, Identifier)
+        session = self._sessions.get(session_id)
+        if session is None:
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Session is not tracked")
+        return session.revision
+
+    def task_identity(self, session_id: str) -> TaskIdentity | None:
+        validated(session_id, Identifier)
+        session = self._sessions.get(session_id)
+        return session.identity if session is not None else None
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _expect(expected, actual):
+        if type(expected) is not int or expected != actual:
+            raise ControlError("stale_revision", f"Expected current revision {actual}")
+
+    def _check_namespace(self, namespace):
+        if namespace != self.namespace:
+            raise ControlError("incompatible_namespace", "Target namespace differs")
+
+    def associate(self, payload: Associate) -> Continuation:
+        payload = validated(payload, Associate)
+        content = payload.target
+        validate_target(content)
+        self._check_namespace(content.namespace)
+        if (
+            content.start_token != 0
+            or content.end_token is not None
+            or content.allow_clip
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Association requires a complete logical prefix"
+            )
+        if isinstance(content, ContentTarget):
+            content = msgspec.structs.replace(
+                content,
+                spans=tuple(
+                    sorted(
+                        content.spans,
+                        key=lambda s: (s.component, s.start_token, s.end_token),
+                    )
+                ),
+            )
+        key = payload.session_id, payload.continuation_id
+        previous = self._continuations.get(key)
+        session = self._sessions.get(payload.session_id)
+        self._expect(payload.expected_revision, previous.revision if previous else 0)
+        parent_id = session.parent_id if session else None
+        if payload.task_parent is not None:
+            parent_id = payload.task_parent.session_id
+            if parent_id == payload.session_id:
+                raise ControlError("conflict", "Task cannot parent itself")
+            self._expect(
+                payload.task_parent.expected_revision, self.session_revision(parent_id)
+            )
+            if session is not None and session.parent_id != parent_id:
+                raise ControlError("conflict", "Task reparenting is unsupported")
+        parent_prefix = payload.parent_prefix
+        if previous is not None:
+            if parent_prefix is not None and parent_prefix != previous.parent_prefix:
+                raise ControlError("conflict", "Continuation parent cannot change")
+            parent_prefix = previous.parent_prefix
+            self._check_extension(previous.content, content)
+        elif parent_prefix is not None:
+            if (parent_prefix.session_id, parent_prefix.continuation_id) == key:
+                raise ControlError("conflict", "Continuation cannot parent itself")
+            parent = self.get(parent_prefix.session_id, parent_prefix.continuation_id)
+            self._expect(parent_prefix.expected_revision, parent.revision)
+            self._check_parent(parent.content, content, parent_prefix.end_token)
+        old_spans, old_tokens = _sizes(previous.content) if previous else (0, 0)
+        spans, tokens = _sizes(content)
+        if (
+            spans > self.limits.max_scope_spans
+            or tokens > self.limits.max_scope_tokens
+            or self._spans - old_spans + spans > self.limits.max_index_spans
+            or self._tokens - old_tokens + tokens > self.limits.max_index_tokens
+            or (session is None and len(self._sessions) >= self.limits.max_sessions)
+            or (
+                previous is None
+                and len(self._continuations) >= self.limits.max_continuations
+            )
+        ):
+            raise ControlError("capacity", "Logical index capacity exhausted")
+        if previous is not None and previous.content == content:
+            return previous
+        # All validation is complete. Publish the replacement and counters together.
+        self.generation += 1
+        if session is None:
+            session = _Session(
+                TaskIdentity(
+                    session_id=payload.session_id, incarnation=self.generation
+                ),
+                self.generation,
+                parent_id,
+                set(),
+                set(),
+            )
+            self._sessions[payload.session_id] = session
+            if parent_id is not None:
+                self._sessions[parent_id].children.add(payload.session_id)
+        record = Continuation(
+            task=session.identity,
+            continuation_id=payload.continuation_id,
+            revision=self.generation,
+            incarnation=previous.incarnation if previous else self.generation,
+            content=content,
+            parent_prefix=parent_prefix,
+        )
+        if previous:
+            self._remove_members(key, previous.content)
+        self._continuations[key] = record
+        session.continuations.add(payload.continuation_id)
+        if isinstance(content, ContentTarget):
+            for span in content.spans:
+                self._members.setdefault(
+                    (cache_compatibility(content), span), set()
+                ).add(key)
+        self._spans += spans - old_spans
+        self._tokens += tokens - old_tokens
+        self._touch(payload.session_id)
+        return record
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _check_extension(old, new):
+        if cache_compatibility(old) != cache_compatibility(new):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "incompatible_namespace",
+                "Continuation cache compatibility cannot change",
+            )
+        if type(old) is not type(new) or _length(new) < _length(old):
+            raise ControlError("conflict", "Continuation identity is append-only")
+        if isinstance(old, TokensTarget):
+            if new.token_ids[: len(old.token_ids)] != old.token_ids:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "conflict", "Continuation tokens cannot be rewritten"
+                )
+        elif old.components != new.components or not set(old.spans).issubset(new.spans):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "conflict", "Continuation descriptors cannot be rewritten"
+            )
+
+    def _check_parent(self, parent, child, end):
+        if cache_compatibility(parent) != cache_compatibility(child):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "incompatible_namespace",
+                "Branch cache compatibility differs from parent",
+            )
+        if not 0 < end <= min(_length(parent), _length(child)):
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Parent prefix boundary is not tracked")
+        if type(parent) is not type(child):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Cannot prove equality across descriptor formats"
+            )
+        if isinstance(parent, TokensTarget):
+            if parent.token_ids[:end] != child.token_ids[:end]:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "conflict", "Branch tokens differ from parent prefix"
+                )
+            return
+        resolution = self._resolve_branch(parent, None, 0, end)
+        if resolution.unaligned:
+            raise ControlError("unaligned", "Parent boundary splits a descriptor")
+        if resolution.missing:
+            raise ControlError("missing", "Parent prefix has missing component history")
+        if parent.components != child.components or not set(resolution.spans).issubset(
+            child.spans
+        ):
+            raise ControlError("conflict", "Branch content differs from parent prefix")
+
+    def _touch(self, session_id):
+        while session_id is not None:
+            session = self._sessions[session_id]
+            session.revision = self.generation
+            session_id = session.parent_id
+
+    def members(
+        self,
+        span: ContentSpan,
+        *,
+        compatibility: CacheCompatibility = CacheCompatibility(),
+    ) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
+        """Reverse lookup of an exact descriptor in this index's namespace."""
+        span = validated(span, ContentSpan)
+        compatibility = validated(compatibility, CacheCompatibility)
+        return tuple(sorted(self._members.get((compatibility, span), ())))
+
+    def token_members(self, prefix: TokensTarget) -> tuple[tuple[str, str], ...]:
+        """Explicit bounded query by token equality; stores no per-token index."""
+        prefix = validated(prefix, TokensTarget)
+        self._check_namespace(prefix.namespace)
+        if prefix.start_token or prefix.end_token is not None or prefix.allow_clip:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid_payload", "Reverse token lookup needs a full prefix"
+            )
+        return tuple(
+            sorted(
+                key
+                for key, record in self._continuations.items()
+                if isinstance(record.content, TokensTarget)
+                and cache_compatibility(record.content) == cache_compatibility(prefix)
+                and record.content.token_ids[: len(prefix.token_ids)]
+                == prefix.token_ids
+            )
+        )
+
+    def resolve(self, target: LogicalTarget) -> ResolvedTarget:
+        target = validated(target, LogicalTarget)
+        validate_target(target)
+        self._check_namespace(target.namespace)
+        if isinstance(target, SessionTarget):
+            revision = self.session_revision(target.session_id)
+            if target.continuation_id is None:
+                records = tuple(
+                    self.get(target.session_id, name)
+                    for name in sorted(self._sessions[target.session_id].continuations)
+                )
+            else:
+                records = (self.get(target.session_id, target.continuation_id),)
+                revision = records[0].revision
+            if target.expected_revision is not None:
+                self._expect(target.expected_revision, revision)
+            if not records:
+                raise ControlError("missing", "Session has no tracked continuations")
+            sources = tuple((record.content, record) for record in records)
+        else:
+            sources = ((target, None),)
+        if (
+            len(sources) > self.limits.max_branches
+            or sum(_sizes(c)[0] for c, _ in sources) > self.limits.max_scope_spans
+            or sum(_sizes(c)[1] for c, _ in sources) > self.limits.max_scope_tokens
+        ):
+            raise ControlError("capacity", "Resolved snapshot exceeds scope limit")
+        branches = []
+        for content, record in sources:
+            end = target.end_token if target.end_token is not None else _length(content)
+            if end <= target.start_token:
+                raise ControlError("missing", "Range starts beyond tracked content")
+            branches.append(
+                self._resolve_branch(content, record, target.start_token, end)
+            )
+        return ResolvedTarget(
+            engine_epoch=self.engine_epoch,
+            namespace=self.namespace,
+            index_generation=self.generation,
+            allow_clip=target.allow_clip,
+            branches=tuple(branches),
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _resolve_branch(content, record, start, end):
+        missing, full, unaligned, dependencies = [], [], [], set()
+        if isinstance(content, TokensTarget):
+            if end > len(content.token_ids):
+                missing.append(
+                    RangeGap(
+                        coverage=TokenRange(
+                            start_token=max(start, len(content.token_ids)),
+                            end_token=end,
+                        ),
+                        reason="untracked_tokens",
+                    )
+                )
+        else:
+            for component in content.components:
+                checkpoints = [
+                    s
+                    for s in content.spans
+                    if s.component == component and s.coverage_kind == "checkpoint"
+                ]
+                if checkpoints:
+                    selected = [s for s in checkpoints if start < s.end_token <= end]
+                    full.extend(selected)
+                    dependencies.update(
+                        TokenRange(
+                            component=component,
+                            start_token=s.dependency_start,
+                            end_token=s.end_token,
+                        )
+                        for s in selected
+                        if s.dependency_start < s.end_token
+                    )
+                    if not selected:
+                        missing.append(
+                            RangeGap(
+                                coverage=TokenRange(
+                                    component=component,
+                                    start_token=start,
+                                    end_token=end,
+                                ),
+                                reason="missing_checkpoint",
+                            )
+                        )
+                    continue
+                window = next(
+                    (
+                        s.window_size
+                        for s in content.spans
+                        if s.component == component and s.coverage_kind == "window"
+                    ),
+                    None,
+                )
+                range_start = max(start, end - window) if window is not None else start
+                cursor = range_start
+                for span in sorted(
+                    (s for s in content.spans if s.component == component),
+                    key=lambda s: s.start_token,
+                ):
+                    left, right = (
+                        max(range_start, span.start_token),
+                        min(end, span.end_token),
+                    )
+                    if left >= right:
+                        continue
+                    if left > cursor:
+                        missing.append(
+                            RangeGap(
+                                coverage=TokenRange(
+                                    component=component,
+                                    start_token=cursor,
+                                    end_token=left,
+                                ),
+                                reason="untracked_content",
+                            )
+                        )
+                    cursor = max(cursor, right)
+                    if span.start_token < range_start or span.end_token > end:
+                        unaligned.append(span)
+                    else:
+                        full.append(span)
+                        if span.dependency_start < span.start_token:
+                            dependencies.add(
+                                TokenRange(
+                                    component=component,
+                                    start_token=span.dependency_start,
+                                    end_token=span.start_token,
+                                )
+                            )
+                if cursor < end:
+                    missing.append(
+                        RangeGap(
+                            coverage=TokenRange(
+                                component=component, start_token=cursor, end_token=end
+                            ),
+                            reason="untracked_content",
+                        )
+                    )
+        return ResolvedBranch(
+            continuation=record,
+            content=content,
+            requested=TokenRange(start_token=start, end_token=end),
+            spans=tuple(full),
+            unaligned=tuple(unaligned),
+            missing=tuple(missing),
+            dependencies=tuple(
+                sorted(
+                    dependencies,
+                    key=lambda r: (r.component, r.start_token, r.end_token),
+                )
+            ),
+        )
+
+    def query(
+        self,
+        *,
+        session_id: str | None = None,
+        cursor: IndexCursor | None = None,
+        limit: int = 256,
+    ) -> AssociationPage:
+        if type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= self.limits.max_page_size:
+            raise ControlError("invalid_cursor", "Page size exceeds limit")
+        if session_id is not None:
+            self.session_revision(session_id)
+        if cursor is not None:
+            cursor = validated(cursor, IndexCursor)
+            if (
+                cursor.engine_epoch != self.engine_epoch
+                or cursor.namespace != self.namespace
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "stale_epoch", "Cursor belongs to another index generation"
+                )
+            if cursor.generation != self.generation:
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "stale_revision", "Index changed; restart pagination"
+                )
+            if (
+                cursor.session_id != session_id
+                or cursor.after not in self._continuations
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "invalid_cursor", "Cursor does not belong to this query"
+                )
+        keys = sorted(
+            key
+            for key in self._continuations
+            if (session_id is None or key[0] == session_id)
+            and (cursor is None or key > cursor.after)
+        )
+        selected = keys[:limit]
+        next_cursor = (
+            IndexCursor(
+                engine_epoch=self.engine_epoch,
+                namespace=self.namespace,
+                generation=self.generation,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                after=selected[-1],
+            )
+            if len(keys) > limit
+            else None
+        )
+        return AssociationPage(
+            engine_epoch=self.engine_epoch,
+            namespace=self.namespace,
+            generation=self.generation,
+            items=tuple(self._continuations[key] for key in selected),
+            session_revisions=tuple(
+                (name, self.session_revision(name))
+                for name in sorted({key[0] for key in selected})
+            ),
+            next_cursor=next_cursor,
+        )
+
+    def finish_task(self, session_id: str, *, expected_revision: int) -> LogicalChange:
+        self._expect(expected_revision, self.session_revision(session_id))
+        todo, removed = [session_id], []
+        while todo:
+            name = todo.pop()
+            removed.append(name)
+            todo.extend(sorted(self._sessions[name].children, reverse=True))
+        identities = tuple(self._sessions[name].identity for name in removed)
+        parent_id = self._sessions[session_id].parent_id
+        self.generation += 1
+        if parent_id is not None:
+            self._sessions[parent_id].children.remove(session_id)
+            self._touch(parent_id)
+        for name in removed:
+            session = self._sessions.pop(name)
+            for continuation_id in session.continuations:
+                self._remove((name, continuation_id))
+        return LogicalChange(index_generation=self.generation, removed_tasks=identities)
+
+    def prune(
+        self, session_id: str, continuation_id: str, *, expected_revision: int
+    ) -> None:
+        record = self.get(session_id, continuation_id)
+        self._expect(expected_revision, record.revision)
+        self.generation += 1
+        self._remove((session_id, continuation_id))
+        self._sessions[session_id].continuations.remove(continuation_id)
+        self._touch(session_id)
+
+    def _remove_members(self, key, content):
+        if isinstance(content, ContentTarget):
+            for span in content.spans:
+                identity = cache_compatibility(content), span
+                members = self._members[identity]
+                members.remove(key)
+                if not members:
+                    del self._members[identity]
+
+    def _remove(self, key):
+        record = self._continuations.pop(key)
+        self._remove_members(key, record.content)
+        spans, tokens = _sizes(record.content)
+        self._spans -= spans
+        self._tokens -= tokens
+
+    def capacity(self) -> dict[str, int]:
+        return {
+            "sessions": len(self._sessions),
+            "continuations": len(self._continuations),
+            "spans": self._spans,
+            "tokens": self._tokens,
+        }

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Stable, bounded model-namespace encoding for actual cache/store lookup keys."""
+
+import hashlib
+
+import msgspec
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.contracts import ControlError
+
+SALT_ENCODING = 'sha256 of compact UTF-8 JSON ["sglang.kv.weight.v1", namespace, original_salt_or_null]'
+
+
+def encode_cache_salt(namespace: str, original_salt: str | None) -> str:
+    if original_salt is not None and not isinstance(original_salt, str):
+        raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Cache salt must be a string or null")
+    try:
+        return hashlib.sha256(
+            msgspec.json.encode(
+                ("sglang.kv.weight.v1", namespace, original_salt or None)
+            )
+        ).hexdigest()
+    except (TypeError, UnicodeError, ValueError) as error:
+        raise ControlError(
+            "invalid_payload", "Cache salt is not valid UTF-8 JSON"
+        ) from error

+        if destination:
+            for work in tuple(self.works.values()):
+                other = placement(work.entry.proposal.action)
+                if (
+                    other
+                    and destination != other
+                    and scopes_overlap(scope, work.entry.proposal.scope)
+                ):
+                    self.cancel(work, "explicit_intent")
+
+    def _matches(self, work, req):
+        tasks = getattr(req, "kv_control_policy_tasks", ())
+        if not set(tasks).intersection(work.tasks):
+            return False
+        context = getattr(req, "kv_control_context", None)
+        if work.binding is not None and (
+            context is None or (context.caller_id, context.binding_id) != work.binding
+        ):
+            return False
+        scope = work.entry.proposal.scope
+        if len(scope.branches) != 1 or not isinstance(
+            scope.branches[0].content, TokensTarget
+        ):
+            return False
+        branch = scope.branches[0]
+        end = branch.requested.end_token
+        content = branch.content
+        raw_salt = getattr(req, "kv_control_logical_cache_salt", req.cache_salt)
+        return (
+            content.cache_salt == raw_salt
+            and content.extra_key == req.extra_key
+            and len(req.origin_input_ids) >= end
+            and tuple(req.origin_input_ids[:end]) == content.token_ids[:end]
+            and req._compute_max_prefix_len(len(req.origin_input_ids)) >= end
+        )
+
+    def before_admission(self, req):
+        matching = [
+            w
+            for w in self.works.values()
+            if w.entry.proposal.prepare_for_admission
+            and not w.cancelled
+            and self._matches(w, req)
+        ]
+        if not matching:
+            return True
+        if (
+            self.runtime.waiting_seconds(req)
+            >= self.service.config.policy_max_wait_seconds
+        ):
+            for work in matching:
+                self.cancel(work, "admission_wait_limit")
+            return True
+        if req.cache_request_handle in self.service.cache.ongoing_prefetch:
+            # Let the real inference prefetch publish its host result rather
+            # than issuing a duplicate cold query/allocation for this request.
+            return False
+        if (
+            getattr(req, "lora_id", None) is not None
+            or getattr(req, "multimodal_inputs", None) is not None
+            or getattr(req, "positional_embed_overrides", None) is not None
+            or req.kv.holds_kv
+            or getattr(req, "beam_group", None) is not None
+            or getattr(req, "dllm_config", None) is not None
+        ):
+            for work in matching:
+                self.cancel(work, "unsupported_preparation_consumer")
+            return True
+        observed = next(
+            (
+                r
+                for r in (
+                    self.runtime._view.requests
+                    if self.runtime._view is not None
+                    else ()
+                )
+                if r.identity == req.kv_control_policy_identity
+            ),
+            None,
+        )
+        available = self.control.executor.transfers._gpu_available()
+        if observed is None or observed.estimated_incremental_tokens is None:
+            for work in matching:
+                self.cancel(work, "unknown_admission_demand")
+            return True
+        if (
+            not all(w.ready for w in matching)
+            and observed.estimated_incremental_tokens > available
+        ):
+            return False
+        for work in matching:
+            work.selected = req.kv_control_policy_identity
+            work.deadline = (
+                req.kv_control_policy_arrival
+                + self.service.config.policy_max_wait_seconds
+            )
+            work.not_before = min(work.not_before, self.control._clock())
+        self.progress()
+        remaining = [
+            w for w in matching if w.ref.operation_id in self.works and not w.cancelled
+        ]
+        return all(w.ready and w.lease is not None and w.lease.ready for w in remaining)
+
+    def allows_candidate(self, req):
+        if (
+            self.runtime.waiting_seconds(req)
+            >= self.service.config.policy_max_wait_seconds
+        ):
+            return True
+        return not any(
+            w.entry.proposal.prepare_for_admission
+            and not w.cancelled
+            and self._matches(w, req)
+            and not w.ready
+            for w in self.works.values()
+        )
+
+    def admitted(self, req):
+        identity = getattr(req, "kv_control_policy_identity", None)
+        for work in tuple(self.works.values()):
+            if work.selected == identity and work.ready:
+                if req.lock is not None:
+                    self.stats["preparations_consumed"] += 1
+                    self.stats["consumed_prefix_tokens"] += min(
+                        req.prefix_len, scope_tokens(work.entry.proposal.scope)
+                    )
+                self._retire(work)
+
+    def request_finished(self, req, *, success, context=None):
+        identity = getattr(req, "kv_control_policy_identity", None)
+        context = context or getattr(req, "kv_control_context", None)
+        binding = (
+            (context.caller_id, context.binding_id) if context is not None else None
+        )
+        for work in tuple(self.works.values()):
+            if binding is not None and work.binding == binding and not success:
+                self.cancel(work, "request_failed")
+            if work.selected == identity and identity is not None:
+                self.cancel(work, "request_finished")
+            if binding is not None and work.wait_binding == binding:
+                if success:
+                    work.wait_binding = None
+                    work.deadline = (
+                        self.control._clock()
+                        + self.service.config.policy_max_delay_seconds
+                    )
+                else:
+                    self.cancel(work, "request_failed")
+        self.progress()
+
+    def cleanup(self, tasks):
+        removed = frozenset(tasks)
+        for work in tuple(self.works.values()):
+            if removed.intersection(work.tasks):
+                self.cancel(work, "task_finished")
+        for key, (_, owners) in tuple(self.paused.items()):
+            if removed.intersection(owners):
+                self.paused.pop(key)
+        self.reap()
+
+    def cancel_all(self):
+        for work in tuple(self.works.values()):
+            self.cancel(work, "owner_reset")
+        self.reap()
+
+    def before_cancel(self, ref):
+        work = self.works.get(ref.operation_id)
+        if work is not None and not self.control.registry.get(ref).status.terminal:
+            self.cancel(work, "caller_cancelled")

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Scheduler-owned bounded observations; no policy receives these live objects."""
+
+from itertools import chain
+
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.policy import (
+    PolicyObservation,
+    PoolObservation,
+    RequestObservation,
+)
+from sglang.srt.managers.schedule_policy import (
+    CLIP_MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
+    running_request_token_offset,
+)
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.unified_cache.component_type import ComponentType
+
+FULL = ComponentType.FULL
+
+
+def _cache_commitment(runtime, req):
+    """Read the native scheduler's fresh match, without a second token walk.
+
+    FULL native matching runs just before this observation. Count unreferenced
+    nodes that admission would protect; they currently appear as reclaimable
+    budget, so treating only new allocation as demand would spend them twice.
+    """
+    executor = runtime.control.executor
+    core = executor.core
+    if (
+        getattr(req, "lora_id", None) is not None
+        or getattr(req, "multimodal_inputs", None) is not None
+    ):
+        return None, None
+    cached = req.prefix_len
+    if cached == 0:
+        return 0, {}
+    selected, length = {}, 0
+    try:
+        node = core.node_by_id(req.last_node)
+        visited = 0
+        while node is not core.root_node:
+            visited += 1
+            if visited > executor.config.max_query_nodes:
+                return None, None
+            cd = node.component_data[FULL]
+            if (
+                cd.value is None
+                or cd.value.numel() != len(node.key)
+                or (
+                    executor.transfers is not None
+                    and executor.transfers._load_pending(node)
+                )
+            ):
+                return None, None
+            length += len(node.key)
+            if cd.lock_ref == 0:
+                selected[node.id] = len(node.key)
+            node = node.parent
+        return (cached, selected) if length == cached else (None, None)
+    except (KeyError, TypeError, AttributeError):
+        return None, None
+
+
+def observe_scheduler(runtime, scheduler, running_batch):
+    cache, control = runtime.service.cache, runtime.control
+    allocator = cache.token_to_kv_pool_allocator
+    free = int(allocator.available_size())
+    evictable = int(cache.tree_core.full_evictable_size())
+    total = int(allocator.size)
+    pool = PoolObservation(
+        "full", "gpu", total, free, total - free - evictable, evictable
+    )
+    candidates = chain(
+        ((r, False) for r in running_batch.reqs),
+        ((scheduler.chunked_req, False),) if scheduler.chunked_req is not None else (),
+        ((r, True) for r in scheduler.waiting_queue),
+    )
+    now = control._clock()
+    records, seen, union = [], set(), {}
+    complete, demand_complete = True, True
+    new_rows = 0
+    for scanned, (req, waiting) in enumerate(candidates):
+        if scanned >= runtime.service.config.max_policy_requests:
+            complete = False
+            break
+        if id(req) in seen or req.finished():
+            continue
+        seen.add(id(req))
+        runtime.register_request(req)
+        tasks = tuple(
+            t
+            for t in getattr(req, "kv_control_policy_tasks", ())
+            if control.index.task_identity(t.session_id) == t
+        )
+        task = tasks[0] if len(tasks) == 1 else None
+        cached, commitment = (
+            _cache_commitment(runtime, req) if waiting else (None, None)
+        )
+        incremental = None
+        growth = None
+        if waiting:
+            if cached is not None:
+                page = cache.page_size
+                input_tokens = max(
+                    0, len(req.origin_input_ids) + len(req.output_ids) - cached
+                )
+                remaining = max(
+                    0, req.sampling_params.max_new_tokens - len(req.output_ids)
+                )
+                allocation = (
+                    (input_tokens + page - 1) // page * page
+                    + min(remaining, CLIP_MAX_NEW_TOKENS)
+                    + page
+                )
+                incremental = allocation + sum(commitment.values())
+                union.update(commitment)
+                new_rows += allocation
+            else:
+                demand_complete = False
+        else:
+            growth = max(
+                0,
+                int(
+                    running_request_token_offset(
+                        req, scheduler.new_token_ratio_tracker.current
+                    )
+                ),
+            )
+        records.append(
+            RequestObservation(
+                req.kv_control_policy_identity,
+                task,
+                waiting,
+                max(0.0, now - req.kv_control_policy_arrival),
+                req.kv_control_policy_order,
+                int(req.kv.kv_allocated_len),
+                cached,
+                incremental,
+                growth,
+            )
+        )
+    return PolicyObservation(
+        now,
+        control.registry.namespace,
+        control.registry.engine_epoch,
+        (pool,),
+        tuple(records),
+        complete,
+        estimated_waiting_tokens=new_rows + sum(union.values())
+        if complete and demand_complete
+        else None,
+    )

+
+class SessionShare(Value):
+    session_id: Identifier

+
+
+class QuotaOptions(Value):
+    shares: Annotated[tuple[SessionShare, ...], msgspec.Meta(max_length=4096)] = ()
+    max_wait_seconds: Seconds = 1.0
+    aging_seconds: Annotated[float, msgspec.Meta(ge=1e-6, le=86400 * 365)] = 1.0
+    importance_ttl: Seconds = 60.0
+    max_states: Annotated[int, msgspec.Meta(ge=1, le=65536)] = 1024

+def validate_definitions(definitions):
+    if len(definitions) > 16 or len({p.name for p in definitions}) != len(definitions):
+        raise ValueError("Configure at most 16 uniquely named local policies")
+    for definition in definitions:
+        values = (
+            (definition.options.ttl_seconds,)
+            if isinstance(definition, PolicyDefinition)
+            else (
+                definition.options.min_pressure,
+                definition.options.min_pause_seconds,
+                definition.options.initial_estimated_transfer_seconds,
+                definition.options.lead_seconds,
+            )
+            if isinstance(definition, ToolWaitDefinition)
+            else (
+                definition.options.max_wait_seconds,
+                definition.options.aging_seconds,
+                definition.options.importance_ttl,
+                definition.options.reuse_score_weight,
+                *(s.weight for s in definition.options.shares),
+            )
+        )
+        if not all(math.isfinite(value) for value in values):
+            raise ValueError("Policy timing, scores and shares must be finite")
+        if isinstance(definition, QuotaDefinition) and len(
+            {s.session_id for s in definition.options.shares}
+        ) != len(definition.options.shares):
+            raise ValueError("Quota share names must be unique")

+def _digest(value):
+    return hashlib.sha256(msgspec.json.encode(value)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def _owner(tasks, target=None):
+    return _digest(("task", tasks)) if tasks else _digest(("content", target))
+
+
+def _claim(policy, owner):
+    return _digest((policy, owner))
+
+
+class RetentionPolicy(KVPolicy):
+    consumed_signals = frozenset({"importance", "resume"})
+
+    def __init__(self, options):
+        self.options = options
+        self.revision = 0
+
+    def on_signal(self, signal, view):
+        if signal.payload.signal not in self.consumed_signals:
+            return None
+        if self.revision >= MAX_INTEGER:
+            raise ControlError("capacity", "Policy revision space exhausted")
+        self.revision += 1
+        return (
+            PolicyProposal(
+                "retain",
+                SetPriority(
+                    target=signal.payload.target,
+                    location=Location(tier="gpu"),
+                    claim_id=signal.owner_key,
+                    revision=self.revision,
+                    value=signal.payload.importance
+                    if signal.payload.importance is not None
+                    else self.options.priority,
+                    ttl_seconds=self.options.ttl_seconds,
+                ),
+                signal.scope,
+            ),
+        )
+
+
+class QuotaPolicy(KVPolicy):
+    consumed_signals = frozenset({"importance", "resume"})
+    observation_categories = frozenset({"capacity", "requests"})
+    uses_guidance = True
+
+    def __init__(self, options):
+        self.options = options
+        self._importance = {}
+
+    def consumes(self, payload):
+        return super().consumes(payload) and isinstance(payload.target, SessionTarget)
+
+    def _expire(self, now):
+        self._importance = {
+            key: value for key, value in self._importance.items() if value[1] > now
+        }
+
+    def on_signal(self, signal, view):
+        self._expire(view.now)
+        if (
+            signal.payload.signal == "importance"
+            and signal.payload.importance is not None
+        ):
+            if (
+                len(set(signal.tasks) - self._importance.keys()) + len(self._importance)
+                > self.options.max_states
+            ):
+                raise ControlError(
+                    "capacity", "Quota importance state capacity exhausted"
+                )
+            for task in signal.tasks:
+                self._importance[task] = (
+                    signal.payload.importance,
+                    view.now + self.options.importance_ttl,
+                )
+        return ()
+
+    def guidance(self, view):
+        self._expire(view.now)
+        gpu = next(
+            (p for p in view.pools if p.component == "full" and p.tier == "gpu"), None
+        )
+        configured = {s.session_id: s.weight for s in self.options.shares}
+        active = {
+            r.task.session_id if r.task is not None else "" for r in view.requests
+        }
+        weights = {name: configured.get(name, 1.0) for name in active}
+        total_weight = sum(weights.values()) or 1.0
+        occupied = {}
+        for request in view.requests:
+            if not request.waiting and request.task is not None:
+                # Per-request held rows are an upper bound when requests share
+                # a prefix. They are advice, never physical reservations.
+                occupied[request.task] = (
+                    occupied.get(request.task, 0) + request.held_tokens
+                )
+        growth_known = all(
+            r.estimated_running_growth is not None
+            for r in view.requests
+            if not r.waiting
+        )
+        growth = sum(
+            r.estimated_running_growth or 0 for r in view.requests if not r.waiting
+        )
+        available = (
+            None
+            if gpu is None or gpu.reclaimable_tokens is None or not growth_known
+            else gpu.free_tokens + gpu.reclaimable_tokens - growth
+        )
+        spare = (
+            self.options.borrow_idle_capacity
+            and view.requests_complete
+            and view.estimated_waiting_tokens is not None
+            and available is not None
+            and view.estimated_waiting_tokens <= available
+        )
+        results = []
+        for request in view.requests:
+            if not request.waiting:
+                continue
+            importance = self._importance.get(request.task, (0, 0))[0]
+            score = (
+                importance / 100 + request.waiting_seconds / self.options.aging_seconds
+            )
+            if request.cached_tokens is not None:
+                score += self.options.reuse_score_weight * request.cached_tokens / 1024
+            admit = True
+            known = (
+                view.requests_complete
+                and request.task is not None
+                and request.estimated_incremental_tokens is not None
+                and gpu is not None
+            )
+            if (
+                known
+                and not spare
+                and request.waiting_seconds < self.options.max_wait_seconds
+            ):
+                name = request.task.session_id
+                share = weights[name] / total_weight
+                admit = occupied.get(
+                    request.task, 0
+                ) + request.estimated_incremental_tokens <= max(
+                    1, int(gpu.total_tokens * share)
+                )
+            results.append(
+                RequestGuidance(
+                    request.identity, admit, score, "" if admit else "session_share"
+                )
+            )
+        return tuple(results)
+
+    def cleanup(self, tasks):
+        for task in tasks:
+            self._importance.pop(task, None)
+
+

+    @staticmethod

+                {

+                    for b in scope.branches

+                key=lambda t: (t.session_id, t.incarnation),

+            ):

+                )
+            combined = set(self._binding_tasks.get(key, ())) | set(tasks)
+            if len(combined) > self.control.limits.max_branches:
+                raise ControlError("capacity", "Policy request task capacity exhausted")
+            self._binding_tasks[key] = tuple(
+                sorted(combined, key=lambda t: (t.session_id, t.incarnation))
+            )
+        view = PolicyObservation(
+            self.control._clock(),
+            self.control.registry.namespace,
+            self.control.registry.engine_epoch,
+        )
+        if any("capacity" in policy.observation_categories for _, policy in consumers):
+            from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.policy import PoolObservation
+
+            allocator = self.service.cache.token_to_kv_pool_allocator
+            free = int(allocator.available_size())

+            self._drop_holds(record, release_holds=release_holds)
+            record.snapshot = msgspec.structs.replace(
+                record.snapshot, state=state, reason=reason
+            )
+
+    def get(self, key: ProtectionKey) -> ProtectionSnapshot | None:
+        self._check()
+        record = self._record(key, self._now())
+        return record.snapshot if record is not None else None
+
+    def expire(self, *, limit: int = 64) -> tuple[ProtectionSnapshot, ...]:
+        """Retire a bounded batch and return unreported expiry/reset changes.
+
+        Lazy expiry in ``get``/``renew`` and reset detection also enqueue their
+        terminal change here. Each key contributes at most one such change,
+        keeping publication work within the revision record bound.
+        """
+        self._check()
+        if type(limit) is not int or not 1 <= limit <= 1 << 24:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "invalid", "Expiry batch must be a bounded positive integer"
+            )
+        now = self._now()
+        expired = self._pending_changes[:limit]
+        del self._pending_changes[:limit]
+        if len(expired) == limit:
+            return tuple(expired)
+        for record in self._records.values():
+            if record.snapshot.state == "active" and record.snapshot.expires_at <= now:
+                self._retire(record, state="expired", reason="ttl_expired")
+                expired.append(record.snapshot)
+                if len(expired) == limit:
+                    break
+        return tuple(expired)
+
+    def cleanup_task(
+        self, *, caller_id: str, task_id: str, task_incarnation: int
+    ) -> tuple[ProtectionSnapshot, ...]:
+        self._check()
+        _identifier(caller_id, "caller_id")
+        _identifier(task_id, "task_id")
+        _revision(task_incarnation)
+        retired = []
+        for key, record in self._records.items():
+            if (key.caller_id, key.task_id, key.task_incarnation) == (
+                caller_id,
+                task_id,
+                task_incarnation,
+            ) and record.snapshot.state == "active":
+                self._retire(record, state="released", reason="task_finished")
+                retired.append(record.snapshot)
+        return tuple(retired)
+
+    def _invalidate(
+        self, reason: str, *, release_holds: bool
+    ) -> tuple[ProtectionSnapshot, ...]:
+        changes = []
+        for record in self._records.values():
+            if record.snapshot.state == "active":
+                self._retire(
+                    record,
+                    state="invalidated",
+                    reason=reason,
+                    release_holds=release_holds,
+                )
+                changes.append(record.snapshot)
+        self._invalidated = reason
+        self._root = None
+        return tuple(changes)
+
+    def invalidate(
+        self, *, reason: str = "cache_cleared"
+    ) -> tuple[ProtectionSnapshot, ...]:
+        self._check()
+        _identifier(reason, "reason")
+        pending = tuple(self._pending_changes)
+        self._pending_changes.clear()
+        return pending + self._invalidate(reason, release_holds=not self._invalidated)
+
+    @property
+    def next_deadline(self) -> float | None:
+        self._check()
+        if self._pending_changes:
+            return self._now()
+        return min(
+            (
+                r.snapshot.expires_at
+                for r in self._records.values()
+                if r.snapshot.state == "active"
+            ),
+            default=None,
+        )
+
+    @property
+    def has_background_work(self) -> bool:
+        self._check()
+        return self._active_count > 0 or bool(self._pending_changes)
+
+    @property
+    def protected_tokens(self) -> int:
+        self._check()
+        return len(self._physical_refs)
+
+    @property
+    def active_claims(self) -> int:
+        self._check()
+        return self._active_count

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Public protocol adapters. Capabilities describe execution, not schema presence."""
+
+import msgspec
+from sglang.srt.managers.kv_control.contracts import (
+    ACTION_VERSION,
+    HASH_SCHEME,
+    PROTOCOL_VERSION,
+    ControlError,
+    CopyTo,
+    Demote,
+    Location,
+    MoveTo,
+    Pin,
+    PrefixTarget,
+    PublicLocation,
+    PublicResult,
+    Status,
+    TargetOutcome,
+    TokensTarget,
+)
+
+PUBLIC_ACTIONS = ("sglang.prefetch", "sglang.demote", "sglang.pin")
+
+
+def public_capabilities(caps):
+    directions = caps.get("directions", {})
+    paths = {}
+    for name, primitive, permitted in (
+        (
+            "sglang.prefetch",
+            "copy_to",
+            (("host", "gpu"), ("storage", "host"), ("storage", "gpu")),
+        ),
+        ("sglang.demote", "move_to", (("gpu", "host"), ("gpu", "storage"))),
+    ):
+        available = (
+            directions.get(primitive, ())
+            if caps.get("available", True)
+            and "sglang." + primitive in caps.get("actions", ())
+            else ()
+        )
+        paths[name] = tuple(p for p in permitted if p in available)
+    pins = caps.get("pin_protections", ()) if caps.get("available", True) else ()
+    actions = {name: (ACTION_VERSION,) for name, values in paths.items() if values}
+    if pins:
+        actions["sglang.pin"] = (ACTION_VERSION,)
+    return dict(
+        protocol_version=PROTOCOL_VERSION,
+        schema_versions={name: (ACTION_VERSION,) for name in PUBLIC_ACTIONS},
+        actions=actions,
+        paths=paths,
+        pin_protections=pins,
+        pin_query="claim" if pins else None,
+        pin_submission=("independent", "attached") if pins else (),
+        pin_request_cached="successful_checkpoint_existing_host_prefix"
+        if pins
+        else None,
+        pin_attached_claim_id="returned_effective_claim_id_per_binding"
+        if pins
+        else None,
+        pin_owner_task="optional_local_index_identity" if pins else None,
+        hash_only_execution=False,
+        prefix=dict(
+            namespace=caps.get("namespace"),
+            layout_id=caps.get("layout_id"),
+            page_size=directions.get("page_alignment"),
+            components=caps.get("components", ()),
+            hash_scheme=HASH_SCHEME,
+            token_material="complete_prefix",
+        ),
+        storage_backend=directions.get("storage_backend"),
+        backend_namespace_selection=bool(directions.get("backend_namespace")),
+        backend_namespace=directions.get("backend_namespace"),
+        storage_targets=directions.get("storage_targets", False),
+        storage_profile=directions.get("storage_profile"),
+        timeout="relative_ms_cancel_and_drain",
+        result_version="1.0",
+    )
+
+
+def normalize_public(payload, caps):
+    capability = public_capabilities(caps)
+    if isinstance(payload, Pin):
+        if (
+            not (
+                capability["pin_protections"]
+                if payload.mode == "acquire"
+                else caps.get("pin_protections", ())
+            )
+            or payload.location.tier != "host"
+            or payload.required_protection != "eviction_exclusion"
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Only local host eviction exclusion is executable"
+            )
+        locations = (payload.location,)
+    else:
+        name = "sglang.demote" if isinstance(payload, Demote) else "sglang.prefetch"
+        path = payload.source.tier, payload.destination.tier
+        if path not in capability["paths"][name]:
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "Public transfer path is not executable")
+        locations = (payload.source, payload.destination)
+    for location in locations:
+        if (
+            location.backend_namespace is not None
+            and location.backend_namespace != capability["backend_namespace"]
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "incompatible_namespace", "Storage backend namespace differs"
+            )
+        if location.tier == "storage" and location.backend not in (
+            None,
+            capability["storage_backend"],
+        ):
+            raise ControlError("unsupported", "Storage backend is not executable")
+    target = payload.target
+    if isinstance(payload, Pin) and payload.mode != "acquire":
+        # Claim identity suffices even after its content/session was removed.
+        return payload
+    if (
+        target != "request_cached"
+        and not isinstance(target, PrefixTarget)
+        and target.allow_clip
+        and (isinstance(payload, Pin) or not payload.allow_partial)
+    ):
+        raise ControlError("invalid_payload", "Clipping requires allow_partial")
+    if isinstance(target, PrefixTarget):
+        c = target.compatibility
+        expected = capability["prefix"]
+        if c.namespace != expected["namespace"]:
+            raise ControlError("incompatible_namespace", "Prefix namespace differs")
+        if (
+            c.layout_id != expected["layout_id"]
+            or c.page_size != expected["page_size"]
+            or set(c.components) != set(expected["components"])
+            or c.hash_scheme != HASH_SCHEME
+        ):
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Prefix layout/page/components/hash scheme differs"
+            )
+        if target.start_token != 0 or target.token_ids is None:
+            raise ControlError(
+                "unsupported", "Execution requires complete token material from zero"
+            )
+        # Blocks are observations, not key material. The executor derives its own
+        # storage keys from tokens and applies encode_cache_salt exactly once.
+        target = TokensTarget(
+            namespace=c.namespace,
+            token_ids=target.token_ids,
+            cache_salt=c.cache_salt or None,
+            layout_id=c.layout_id,
+        )
+    if isinstance(payload, Pin):
+        return msgspec.structs.replace(payload, target=target)
+    primitive = MoveTo if isinstance(payload, Demote) else CopyTo
+    return primitive(
+        target=target,
+        src=Location(
+            tier=payload.source.tier,
+            engine_id=payload.source.engine_id,
+            backend=payload.source.backend,
+            backend_namespace=payload.source.backend_namespace,
+        ),
+        dst=Location(
+            tier=payload.destination.tier,
+            engine_id=payload.destination.engine_id,
+            backend=payload.destination.backend,
+            backend_namespace=payload.destination.backend_namespace,
+        ),
+    )
+
+
+def project_result(current, update, sequence):
+    """Project only per-target completion evidence; queued I/O proves no readiness."""
+    public = current.public_result or PublicResult(
+        owner_epoch=current.ref.context.engine_epoch,
+        state_version=sequence,
+        outcome_sequence=sequence,
+    )
+    ready = tuple(
+        o for o in update.target_outcomes if "destination_ready" in o.completed_steps
+    )
+    reclaimed = tuple(
+        o for o in update.target_outcomes if "source_reclaimed" in o.completed_steps
+    )
+    demote = current.action_type == "sglang.demote"
+    accepted = (
+        tuple(
+            o
+            for o in update.target_outcomes
+            if o.status in (Status.ACCEPTED, Status.RUNNING)
+            or "destination_ready" in o.completed_steps
+            or "protection_active" in o.completed_steps
+        )
+        or public.accepted_scope
+    )
+    missing = tuple(o for o in update.target_outcomes if o.status == Status.MISSING)
+    blocked = tuple(
+        o
+        for o in update.target_outcomes
+        if o.status in (Status.DEFERRED, Status.PARTIAL)
+        and "source_reclaimed" not in o.completed_steps
+    )
+    if not update.target_outcomes and update.status in (
+        Status.MISSING,
+        Status.DEFERRED,
+    ):
+        scope = tuple(
+            msgspec.structs.replace(
+                o, status=update.status, code=update.code, reason=update.reason
+            )
+            for o in public.requested_scope
+        )
+        if update.status == Status.MISSING:
+            missing = scope
+        else:
+            blocked = scope
+    return msgspec.structs.replace(
+        public,
+        state_version=sequence,
+        outcome_sequence=sequence,
+        accepted_scope=accepted,
+        ready_scope=ready,
+        ready_location=PublicLocation(**msgspec.to_builtins(ready[0].location))
+        if ready
+        else None,
+        preserved_scope=ready if demote else (),
+        reclaimed_scope=reclaimed if demote else (),
+        missing_scope=missing,
+        blocked_scope=blocked,
+    )
+
+
+def requested_outcomes(scope):
+    return tuple(
+        TargetOutcome(coverage=branch.requested, branch_index=i, status=Status.RECEIVED)
+        for i, branch in enumerate(scope.branches)
+    )
